Continue walking around the roof to find another body that's being eaten by a Crab . Loot the body to obtain x4 Thin Beast Bones . Continue south and you'll find another body being eaten by a Crab , check the body to find x2 Strip of White Flesh . Next, jump on the floating log to reach a large broken-up circular platform. The path here is fairly straightforward, try to reach the opposite end by using the floating logs and wooden platforms, and make sure to loot the body on the circular platform to find x1 Great Grave Glovewort . Retrace your steps to the rooftop of the building where you looted bodies and killed the small Crabs, and this time, head west where you can jump across to progress (see the second image above for reference). Once you're across, walk around the sides to reach the platform and loot the body that is guarded by Ignited Putrid Corpse enemies to obtain x1 Fireproof Pickled Liver . Jump back onto the sides of this building so you can walk to the top and proceed west where you'll have to do a running jump to safely land on top of another roof of a building. On the roof of the building, you should encounter a Fire Knight enemy walking around. Kill it and then loot the body that's near the spot where the Fire Knight enemy was walking to obtain x3 Ember of Messmer . Keep going straight until you reach a wall, then turn around to find a body sitting against one of the roof's structures. Loot it to acquire x1 Slumbering Egg [ See Shadow of the Erdtree Map ]. THE PRAYER ROOM: FIRE KNIGHT QUEELIGN Next, face the east side of the compass and you should see a narrow ramp structure of one of the churches. Do a running jump to land on it safely, then walk to the top where you'll find two large openings or holes on the big roof. Slowly drop down onto the narrow structure that's on the right side, then you can walk down so you can safely run onto the other structure that is on the left so you can loot the body that holds x3 Stormhawk Feathers [ See Shadow of the Erdtree Map ]. Go back and then drop down onto the opening of a ceiling (see the third image above for reference). Below, you should immediately see yet another corpse next to a small Crab . Loot the body to find x1 Lightningproof Pickled Liver . Go around, northeast, and you'll locate a locked door, this is the Prayer Room that requires the Prayer Room Key , a key that drops upon defeating the NPC Invader Fire Knight Queelign , encountered for the second time at the Church of the Crusade [ See Shadow of the Erdtree Map ]. If you have the key, you can unlock the door and find Fire Knight Queelign (NPC) in the flesh. Now, if you have an item called the Iris of Occultation , you can give it to the NPC, and after Queelign's dialogue, the NPC will drop a weapon you can loot. This weapon is Queelign's Greatsword . NOTE : If you give the Iris of Grace to Queelign, you'll receive the Spirit Ash " Fire Knight Queelign ". The Iris of Occultation can be acquired in many ways, one way is by obtaining it as an item drop from defeating a Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit located in this area after you drain the flood. THE FLOODED CHURCH DISTRICT: DRAINING THE FLOOD Exit the prayer room and proceed to the northwest doorway, but before proceeding further, be sure to enter the armory room on the left to find a body sitting against the wall. Loot the body to find x1 Rune of an Unsung Hero . Enter the hallway and kill the first Fire Knight enemy that you see, on the left side of the hallway, loot the body resting against the wall to find x2 Furlcalling Finger Remedy , and continue straight down the hallway where you'll encounter another Fire Knight . The room ahead is not accessible at the moment and the doorway to the right where you'll notice Marika's statue that has a glowing item in its hand is unreachable, so exit through the first doorway on the left side of the hallway. NOTE: In the same hallway, there are two doorways on the left, the far most or second doorway will lead you to a lift that takes you to the Specimen Storehouse section of the Shadow Keep. You're free to roam here, but we highly recommend returning to the Specimen Storehouse after clearing the Main Plaza and Church District of the Shadow Keep. What you can do is enter the Specimen Storehouse, and activate the nearby Site of Grace (Storehouse, Back Section) so you can just fast travel here after exploring the Church District. Cross the pathway where you'll encounter two Giant Bat enemies, then walk up to the short steps where you'll encounter another Giant Bat ahead. Jump over the gap, and kill the creature. Now before going straight, walk up a bit and you'll find a corner on the right. It's a dead end but there's a body that you can loot that's being protected by another Giant Bat hanging from the ceiling. Kill the enemy and loot the body to acquire x3 Hefty Beast Bone [ See Shadow of the Erdtree Map ]. Next, climb the ladder next to a doorway to find the mechanism that drains the water. You can also return to the hallway to get the item sitting on the hand of Marika's statue. You can get the item by jumping on the hand, it may require a few tries as the platform that you need to stand on is quite narrow. Loot the item to acquire x1 Scadutree Fragment , then prepare to fight a group of Ignited Putrid Corpse as you jump down. Behind the same statue, you can find the Fire Knight's Seal weapon [ See Shadow of the Erdtree Map ] EXPLORING THE SUNKEN CHAPEL KILL THE LESSER ULCERATED TREE SPIRIT BY THE LARGE TREE For some clarity, we recommend that you start by fast-traveling to the Church District Entrance checkpoint [ See Shadow of the Erdtree Map ] since you can now use the lift near the Site of Grace. From the checkpoint, go left, use the lever to call the lift, then step on the center to ride it down. You'll now be able to explore the open area of the Sunken Chapel. At the center, you will see a large tree, only approach the tree if you're prepared to fight because a Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit will emerge beneath the ground. Killing it will drop the Mantle of Thorns , and resting against the tree is a corpse holding x1 Somber Smithing Stone [5] . DEFEAT THE SECOND LESSER ULCERATED TREE SPIRIT The second Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit is located around the east area of the sunken chapel (see the images above for reference). Defeating it will drop x1 Iris of Occultation which (if you don't have it yet) you can give to Fire Knight Queelign ( see here ) in the Prayer Room to obtain Queelign's Greatsword . Also in the east area, you can find open buildings. One building houses two bodies that you can loot to find x4 Smithing Stone [4] and x6 Kukri [ See Shadow of the Erdtree Map ]. There is also building another where you'll find a pack of Crabs and Giant Crab enemies, one roaming around, and the other next to another body that you can loot to find x1 Shadow Realm Rune [5] . [ See Shadow of the Erdtree Map ]. If you continue to go around this area, you'll reach the west side where you'll find the Sunken Chapel Site of Grace [ See Shadow of the Erdtree Map ] FIND THE TREE-WORSHIP SITE OF GRACE Head north towards the entrance of the main church then immediately turn left to find a corpse by a corner. Loot the body to find x3 Shadow Sunflower . Clear out the enemies then approach the small room that has Marika's statue (the same statue where you got the Scadutree Fragment and the Fire Knight's Seal weapon. Make a right and you'll enter a large room. Straight ahead, you'll see some stairs on both ends, walk up to the upper platform and investigate the railings to discover a body hanging on top of it. Loot the body to obtain the Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [1] , [ See Shadow of the Erdtree Map ]. Walk back down the stairs and check under the upper platform to find a door. Open that door and you'll find another lift that takes you underground. Ride it to find and activate the Tree-Worship Passage Site of Grace [ See Shadow of the Erdtree Map ]. SCADUTREE AVATAR After activating the Tree-Worship Passage Site of Grace, follow the path going down, then cross the bridge. Enter the structure through the archway, and you'll find the Iris of Grace (you can give this to Fire Knight Queelign , see here ) if you still haven't obtained it. Go down the stairs on either side, and you can activate the Tree-Worship Sanctum Site of Grace [ See Elden Ring Map ]. South of the Site of Grace, you can find x1 Marika's Rune on a corpse sitting against the wall. North of the Tree-Worship Sanctum Site of Grace, you can go through the boss fog to fight the Scadutree Avatar at the Scadutree Base . The Scadutree Avatar uses its tree trunk-like arms to attack. It has different attacks, such as uprooting thorns over an area. There is a dedicated page here containing information on how to defeat the Scadutree Avatar . After defeating the Scadutree Avatar , you will receive the Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower along with Miquella's Great Rune . From here, (if you followed the tip earlier by activating the Storehouse, Back Section checkpoint in the Specimen Storehouse) you can fast travel to the Storehouse, Back Section Site of Grace to start exploring the Back Section of the Specimen Storehouse. Upon entering, look to the right immediately to see a noble corpse against the wall. Loot it to obtain x1 Somber Smithing Stone [9] . Proceed to the left side, through the doorway, where you'll find the Storehouse, Back Section checkpoint. Continue moving straight until you walk past a ladder. Do not climb the ladder first, instead, keep going straight to find some items. First, look to your left to see, another noble corpse sitting against a desk, loot it to obtain x3 Glintslab Firefly . Then at the end, you'll see a Fire Knight and three Shadow Undead standing next to another corpse, kill the enemies then loot the body to acquire x1 Carian Thrusting Shield . Go back and climb the ladder to the top where you'll encounter another Fire Knight and two Shadow Undead reading a book. You can sneak behind the enemies to backstab them. Continue to the right side and walk carefully up the stairs to avoid aggravating the Fire Knight, roaming the floor above. At the top of the stairs, turn to the corner on the right to find a corpse to loot x3 Fire Coil . Kill the enemies on this floor, then continue moving straight. You'll discover another noble corpse sitting against a small table, loot it to obtain x4 Rada Fruit , and go straight towards the balcony to find another noble corpse that holds the Fire Serpent incantation. Go back, and look behind the bookcase to find an opening on the wall. Through the opening, turn right and you'll find another noble corpse sitting by the edge of the narrow scaffolding. Loot the body to acquire x6 Shadow Sunflower . Continue going up, and by the ramp, you should find another noble corpse that you can loot to obtain x1 Blessed Bone Shard . Continue going up and you'll arrive at the loft section of the storehouse. Activate the Storehouse, Loft Site of Grace before you proceed to explore. STOREHOUSE, LOFT Once you have activated the Storehouse, Loft Site of Grace, proceed to the lift north of the Site of Grace to go up. You will end up on beams above the Specimen Storehouse. This level will be filled with Giant Bats roaming the area. The only path you can follow will be the one going west, so keep following it. There will be a lot of ways you can walk on the beams, but the only way you can progress through this area is through the ladder. Pick up x7 Thin Beast Bones from a body at the edge of a beam, then go up the ladder that you walk past through just before picking up the loot. After climbing the ladder, you will arrive in a new level. If you go to the southeast section of the level, you can find x4 Smithing Stone [7] from a dead body. Following the path from the south side will lead you to a pillar blocking your way. If you look down, you can find a platform that you can jump off of, and it will contain the Wrath from Afar incantation. Next, jump on the beam to the north, then climb up the nearby ladder to the west of where you landed. You will end up on the beam that a pillar was blocking earlier. You can aggro the bats here, so be careful when attacking as you might fall off of the beams. You can find a lift in the middle of the beam going west with an item above it, along with a Fire Knight on a nearby beam which will be hostile if you approach the lift. If you use the lift to go down, you will end up in an area with a Fire Knight facing the other way around. You can easily dispose of the Fire Knight by backstabbing it and staggering it continuously. After dealing with the Fire Knight, you can pick up x1 Rune of an Unsung Hero on the southwestern corner of the area. The area will be clear, and you can head back up the beams using the lift. If you want to get the item above, you can ride the lift, then exit it before going down. A second lift will arrive just beside it, then do it again. Jump on the roof of the first lift just as it is arriving, and you will be able to reach the item, which is a Fire Knight Hilde summon. If you walk across the beam going west, you can climb down a ladder. On your left, just around the corner, you can loot a body for x4 Rada Fruit . Directly northeast of the ladder you descended on, you will find another ladder you can use to descend. You will reach an area similar to the Site of Grace. If you head outside the archway on the northwestern side of the area, you will find a lift directly on your right. Take the lift going down, then keep following the scaffolding until you reach an area with a door and a lift. You cannot open the door yet, so use the lift nearby to go down. The lift will then lead you to the Shadow Keep, Back Gate Site of Grace [ See Elden Ring Map ]. This area leads you into two areas. There is a room on the east, just beside the Site of Grace. In this room, you can pick up x1 Scadutree Fragment . After that, you will see an archway heading outside on the north-northeast side of the room. This is a boss area in which you will be fighting Commander Gaius . For a more detailed guide on how to defeat Commander Gaius , you may go to this page. Defeating Commander Gaius will give you the Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider . It will also give access to Scaduview region. We don't recommend fighting him right away, instead, make your way to the Cerulean Coast (Southern Shore) to minimize backtracking. This covers the Church District part of your Shadow Keep exploration. See the next tab for the Cerulean Coast (Southern Shore) Walkthrough. Click here to return to the tab selection. Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Cerulean Coast/Southern Shore Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree - Southern Shore (First Entrance) Travel from Ellac River Downstream - Site of Grace in Gravesite Plain and navigate the path to Cerulean Coast Look for the Forager Brood to receive the Cookbook. This one is located Northeast of the Cerulean Coast - Site of Grace Reach Cerulean Coast Fight Ghostflame Dragon Reach Southern Shore Pick up Map: Southern Shore Explore Stone Coffin Fissure Summon Thiollier to fight the Putrescent Knight Defeat Putrescent Knight Reach Garden of Deep Purple Progress Thiollier and St. Trina's Questline Reach Southern Nameless Mausoleum and defeat Dancer of Ranah Make your way to Finger Ruins of Rhia by following the path in Eastern Coast Progress Count Ymir and Jolan's Questline ( Please see the Finger Ruins Walkthrough Tab ) Exploring Cerulean Coast Teleport to Castle Front - Site of Grace (this is in front of Castle Ensis ). Face south, then turn left on the first dirt path. Stay on this path until a small encampment near the river comes into view. Head towards them and remain on this new dirt path. As you see the Bloodfiends and Messmer soldiers fighting, turn left again, to head towards the river. Continue down here until you get to the toxic swamp and then remain on the left side. Watch out for the Miranda Sprout of varying sizes here. Go past the swamp and keep heading west. Keep to the left side and then jump down on the river where you see the giant Miranda Sprout . Go through the narrow entryway next to it. Once you are inside the cave, turn left, and another left until you see the site of grace. Activate the Ellac River Cave - Site of Grace before proceeding so you have a checkpoint. Next, jump down the rocks while facing south. Be careful on your way down here because you can fall off and result in an instant death. Follow the stream of the waterfall here and take your time jumping down between the stone pillars. Once you reach the lower level, you will find gravebirds on top of pillars as you're heading south. Go through them and ride as fast as you can while sprinting with Torrent . After this area, you will jump between stone pillars again, so you need to be careful here. As you reach another lower area, you can activate another Site of Grace, the Ellac River Downstream. Continue heading south and jump down the rocks on the right side. As you reach the lower level, you will see a giant stone pillar on your left. Cross to the other side using it as a bridge. This will take you to the ground level and you're now close to reaching Cerulean Coast. Continue riding south and go past the creatures here. As the Furnace Golem comes into view, switch to the area on the right side and remain there. It's up to you if you want this Furnace Golem, but we recommend on getting the Site of Grace first, then backtrack here to fight it later. Continue riding south and hug this area on your right until you come across a big gap in the wall. Go through it and you will enter an area of blue flowers. You can now activate the Cerulean Coast - Site of Grace directly ahead of you. Then, you can backtrack to the area where you saw the Furnace Golem . You can also locate the Forager Brood near the forest of lightning rams here. You will receive the Forager Brood Cookbook [3] from it. Return to the Cerulean Coast - Site of Grace. Your first stop here is obtaining the Map: Southern Shore . Head south and go past the 3 small patches of land. A Ghostflame Dragon will come swooping down here but you can just outrun it if you don't want to fight it. If you want to defeat it, you can obtain a Dragon Heart and a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone upon killing it. Head south and go past the glowing worm creatures. You will spot the map to your right as you climb a flowery slope cut between jagged rock. After obtaining the map, continue up the slope then make a left to travel southeast. You will reach Miquella's Cross here next to a Site of Grace. Pick up the Scadutree Fragment and interact with the Cerulean Coast - Site of Grace. This time, travel west and stick to the cliff on your left. As you're passing through the glowing worm-like creatures, and heap up the slope. Watch out for the giant that will throw boulders at you here. You can kill it for a Hefty Cracked Pot . Continue traveling south until you see a large hole in the ground. Carefully navigate to the bottom by jumping down. You can minimize fall damage by riding Torrent as you go down and at the bottom, you will reach The Fissure - Site of Grace. The St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [2] can found in a cliff within the area. From Cerulean Coast Cross follow the path south until the very end to the highest cliff of the mountain. It is nearby the hole but not in the hole. Exploring Stone Coffin Fissure From the Site of Grace, head south and jump between the platforms until you see an enemy slime on the ground. Go past it and climb the ramp behind it and pick up x5 Congealed Putrescence at the edge. Then, face the north direction and jump down in this thick pillar ahead of you. Make a right and pick up x10 St. Trina's Arrow from the corpse on the ground. Make a U-turn and watch out for a Bloodfiend here as you go down. It will come from the edge of the pillar. You can eliminate this enemy or just run away from it. On the edge of this area, you will see this floor at the cliff. This is a collapsing ground and you can stand on it so you can reach the lower level. There are multiple bloodfiends here and you can eliminate them for a chance to get their items like Bloodfiend's Fork , String , or Runes. Head north towards the cliff where you see a corpse on the ground. Pick up x2 Deep-Purple Lily from this corpse. Then, face the southeast and find the way to the center of the dungeon. You will see 2 more Cursed Bloodfiends here sitting on the upper deck. Go towards them and defeat them. You can pick up the Shadow Realm Rune [3] behind them. Fissure Cross - Site of Grace Face the east direction where you see Miquella's Cross and a Site of Grace. Walk over it and take the Scadutree Fragment on the ground and make sure to activate the Fissure Cross - Site of Grace. From here, face northwest where you see a large chunk of collapsed stone. There is a platform that lets you jump down to the lower section. When you reach the bottom, face east and head to the lower level. Beware of the slimes that will fall from the ceiling. To the left, you can pick up the Velvet Sword of St. Trina tucked at the end of this short cave. Go to the other path where a Gravebird is resting on the edge. Do a sneak attack and then pick up the Nectarblood Burgeon from where it was sitting. Jump down the edge and then pick up the Grave Glovewort [3] right where you will land. Face north and go up the ramp. There's another Gravebird here with purple markings on its wings. When you reach the slanted area, you will fight another Gravebird. Going to the top, you can pick up a Grave Glovewort [2] from a corpse. Then, head down through the broken bridge here. There are caterpillar-like enemies here on your path and they can shoot out laser-like projectiles. You can try to run from them or just take them out so it's safer to navigate later on. Once you make it to the toppled building on the other side, go to the left side by facing west where you see these stone clusters. You can trigger the explosions by getting near them and then back off as they explode. You can pick up a Grave Glovewort [8] at the end here. Then, go to the right side by facing east and go to the top of the building. Jump down on the left side to pick up Nectarblood Burgeon and x2 Smithing Stone [6] here. To continue your progress, face northeast where you see another caterpillar-like enemy. Ideally, you want to get rid of this so it will not bother you later. Then, jump down behind the caterpillar, and jump past another stone cluster of enemies. When you see this Site of Grace come into view, go to the right side first. Pick up the Grave Glovewort [7] from this corpse on the edge. Then, activate the Fissure Waypoint Site of Grace. While facing northeast, jump to the other platform and then jump down to the lower level. Cross the bridge and pick up the Mass of Putrescence on the other side. To continue your progress, face northeast and go up the ramp. Watch out for the fire-throwing enemies. When you get to the upper area, you can pick up Nectarblood Burgeon and Congealed Putrescence . You can just ignore these enemies after getting the item and continue going up the ramp. At the top, you will find an archway next to a Skeleton Archer. Fight the Spirit Form of Misbegotten Crusader Jump down the archway but watch out for the giant slime here. Take the path to your left and you will be fighting the spirit of the Misbegotten Crusader . It will drop the Multilayered Ring of Light upon defeating it. Then, jump on the platform to the southeast and cross the bridge to your left. You can pick up x3 Nectarblood Burgeon here. Then, face southeast and follow the faint glimmer of the Site of Grace. Activate it and walk up the ramp. Go towards the horned statue and jump down. At the bottom, you will reach a boss arena. You will be fighting the Putrescent Knight here, a skeleton riding a horse. It wields a massive weapon that behaves like a boomerang and can be thrown in an arc projectile. This boss can deal a good amount of damage and you can check out our Putrescent Knight page to see more info on how to defeat this boss. This boss will drop Remembrance of Putrescence upon defeating it. A new Site of Grace will be revealed after the fight and it will also unlock the entrance to the Garden of Deep Purple. Go inside the cave and pick up the items inside. There are Nectarblood Burgeons on the ground and a St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [3] here. Talk to St. Trina by interacting with the bright purple flower here. This marks the beginning of Thiollier's quest which requires you to return to Pillar Path Cross - Site of Grace and speak with him there. You can also view Thiollier's page to know more about his questline. For now, you are done in this dungeon and you will return to Cerulean Coast - Site of Grace to continue exploring this region. Southern Nameless Mausoleum Head to the southernmost location which is towards the edge of a cliff and near a withered tree. From there, check the left to find a narrow path (below the tree) that leads to a hole that you can drop to enter a cave. The location is an arena where you can fight against a mini-boss, the Dancer of Ranah . When you reach the bottom, face the compass towards the west and go straight until you exit the cave. You can ride your mount here and avoid fighting the Giant Crab inside the cave. As you exit, you should find yourself on the small island if you open the map. Make a right towards the shore, then up the hill on the left where you'll find a field of blue glowing flowers and the mausoleum. By the entrance, there is a Summoning Pool or effigy for players to use for co-op. There is also a Stake of Marika that you can use to respawn by the entrance of the mausoleum in case you die. As mentioned, the location is where you'll fight against a mini-boss, so make preparations before you pass through the mist. For guides and strategies on how to defeat the boss, please visit the Dancer of Ranah page or view the video guide above. Defeating this mini-boss rewards the player with the following items: Dancer's Set Dancing Blade of Ranah When you're done here, your next location is to travel to Finger Ruins of Rhia. You can go there from Cerulean Coast and you can read on the next section to find out how to get there. See the next tab for the Finger Ruins of Rhia Walkthrough. Click here to return to the tab selection. Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Finger Ruins of Rhia Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Finger Ruins of Rhia: This location is accessible from the Cerulean Coast Make your way to the Finger Ruins of Rhia from Cerulean Coast Travel to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr to speak with Count Ymir and Jolan Progress their questline NOTE : This section follows your encounter with Count Ymir and after exploring the Church District of Shadow Keep, traveling to Cerulean Coast, and Charo's Hidden Grave. By now, you would have acquired the O Mother (Gesture near a cliff in Bonny Village ), Ruins Map , and Hole-Laden Necklace from your first meeting with Count Ymir . IMPORTANT : This game progress spans multiple Finger Ruins: Rhia, Dheo, and Miyr. You can reach the first finger ruins from Cerulean Coast, and the second one will require you to travel to Shadow Keep, Back Gate, and the third one will be discovered as you progress Count Ymir's questline. To minimize backtracking, you need to complete Shadow Keep - Church District first. This section will only focus on the Finger Ruins of Rhia, which is a location that you can access from Cerulean Coast. Finger Ruins of Rhia You can reach the Finger Ruins of Rhia by traveling southeast from the Cerulean Coast - Site of Grace. Go past the toppled pillar and stick to the wall on your left side. Continue following it as you go up the ramp and past the glowing worm creatures. You will come around and find the entrance past the shoreline and behind the dragon. Go up the ramp and you will see a small-altar-like structure at the very end. You can pick up the Grave Glovewort (9) here. On the right side, you can jump down to activate the Ruins of Rhia Site of Grace. Down here, you will be fighting Fingercreepers and the Man-Serpents . Follow the trail and make your way to the end of the path. Once you reach the bell, interact with it and you will be granted the Crimson Seed Talisman +1 . Before leaving this area, explore the southwestern area of the ruins for a path with cerulean blossoms. Follow it west until you reach Finger-Weaver's Hovel , where you can obtain Finger-Weaver's Cookbook (1) . This is the end of the exploration of the Finger Ruins of Rhia. When you're done here, return to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and speak with Count Ymir again and he will grant you the Ruins Map (2nd) and Beloved Stardust . The questlines of Count Ymir and Jolan will be put on hold while make your way to Charo's Hidden Grave . You are going there to meet the NPC named Dragon Communion Priestess , but before that, you will explore Dragon's Pit first and defeat the dungeons boss to unlock the path to Charo's Hidden Grave and the Jagged Peak . See the next tab for the Charo's Hidden Grave Walkthrough. Click here to return to the tab selection. Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Dragon's Pit Path to Charo's Hidden Grave Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree - Reaching Charo's Hidden Grave Explore Dragon's Pit Reach the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion Reach Charo's Hidden Grave Fight Death Rite Bird Defeat Furnace Golem Clear Lamenter's Gaol NOTE : If you have been following this walkthrough, you would have unlocked Dragon's Pit - Site of Grace. All you need to do is teleport there and skip the bullet guide on how to reach Dragon's Pit. If you haven't unlocked Dragon's Pit, read below: Teleport to Castle Front - Site of Grace Head southeast and follow the dirt path Go past the small army camp here Stay on the dirt path (you may encounter a hostile NPC called Ancient Dragon-Man here) Continue following this path and you will see Dragon's Pit Entrance on the left side The Entrance from Dragon's Pit (The other side of Southern Shore) Its entrance is a tight cave marked by torches outside. Once you enter the cave, you will eventually encounter the Dragon's Pit Site of Grace. Continuing through the cave, you will enter a more spacious part that resembles a ritual room. There are skeleton enemies here that you need to take out. Afterward, loot the corpse at the back of the ritual area inside a mini cave to obtain a Smithing Stone [1] . Exit the mini cave and turn left, following another tight path until you reach a cliff with a ledge path to the left. Follow the ledge and drop onto the platform below where a skeleton enemy is waiting. After defeating the enemy, go to the altar on the left and loot the corpse to find the Shadow Realm Rune [2] . Turn left from the altar and navigate another tight part of the cave until you enter a room with multiple skeleton enemies and a staircase leading up. Clear the area, then head up the staircase to find a corpse on the left holding Knot Resin . On the right, you will encounter a Lesser Magma Wyrm. After slaying the dragon, loot the corpse near a hole to obtain a Smithing Stone [5] . Return to the staircase and head downstairs until you see another tight part of the cave. After passing through, you will enter a larger section with small structures and torches. Proceed straight ahead and drop down the cliff. Though it’s a long fall, it won't kill you. Upon landing, you will immediately see a yellow mist indicating a boss ahead. Before proceeding through the mist, look back to find a corpse holding a Smithing Stone [4] . The boss in this area is the Ancient Dragon-Man . For a detailed guide on how to defeat this boss, refer to the Ancient Dragon-Man page. This boss drops the Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana . After defeating the Ancient Dragon-Man , look to the other side where you'll find a large double door. Loot the boss and proceed through this door to reach the Dragon's Pit Terminus Site of Grace, which is also the path leading to the Jagged Peak Region where all the dragons reside. This indicates that defeating the Ancient Dragon-Man unlocks the path to the Jagged Peak Region. Into the Dragon Area From the Dragon's Pit Terminus - Site of Grace, head towards the east where you will encounter Jagged Peak Drake, this is a dragon resting in the middle of the open ground. It's up to you if you want to fight this dragon but you can just skip it and head west so you can avoid it. If you decide to fight it, the Jagged Peak Drake can breathe fire and stomp you with its massive legs and wings. When defeated, it drops a Dragon Heart and Dragonscale Flesh . Then, head towards the south where the path narrows. You will encounter skeletons and some fire-breathing enemies here. After a while, you will find a new location called Grant Altar of Dragon Communion. Speak to the NPC named Dragon Communion Priestess to receive Ancient Dragon's Blessing . There's also a nearby Site of Grace that you can activate here. This is your last stop before heading to Charo's Hidden Grave. Charo's Hidden Grave Head up the dragon's body by facing southwest. Climb it to the top then face south until the red flowers come into view. Then,turn right to formally enter Charo's Hidden Grave. Head southwest until you make it to Charo's Hidden Grave. This area is filled with various gravesite locations and are guarded by mostly skeleton enemies. This is a location filled with red flowers on the ground and is the area above Cerulean Coast. Jump down into the water and then pick up the Grave Keeper's Cookbook [2] Continue riding northwest and you will see a Tibia Mariner here on the water. Defeat this enemy to obtain Tibia's Cookbook . After defeating the Tibia Mariner, you can head east to find a Grave Keeper's Brainpan which is surrounded by trees and rocks on a drop. Then, continue riding northwest to activate the Charo's Hidden Grave Site of Grace [ See Elden Ring Map ] before a small archway and near the cliff edge. From here, you can even see the Cerulean Coast at the lower area. Northeast of the Site of Grace, you can find a Deathbird statue surrounded by Gravebirds , in which you'll find the Rings of Spectral Light sorcery at the base of the statue. Beyond this area, you will fight a Death Rite Bird . This is an optional boss found in the middle of the body of the lake here. If you defeat the Death Rite Bird in this place, you will obtain the Ash of War: Ghostflame Call . Now, return to the Site of Grace, then head north to obtain the Spirit Glaive halberd. Afterwards, you can head southwest until you encounter a Hippopotamus . Defeat it, and you will obtain a Scadutree Fragment from it as a drop. Head west and go past the Blue Worms . You will start to see metal barricades and broken prison cages. Stick to the wall on your right and you will find the entrance to Lamenter's Gaol with red flowers leading to it. Head inside until you find the Lamenter's Gaol Site of Grace [ See Elden Ring Map ] Lamenter's Gaol At the Lamenter's Gaol Site of Grace [ See Elden Ring Map ], keep following the path going southeast until you arrive near a locked gate. Before the locked gate, there will be an opening on the left side of the wall. Go through the path on your left, then keep following the path. You'll find two rooms with an open gate on the right side as you are traversing the path. The first room will only contain a Putrid Corpse . In the second room, you will encounter two Putrid Corpses. After dealing with the enemies in this room, open the chest to receive x1 Gaol Upper Level Key , which will be used to open the locked gate that you encountered earlier. Return to the path then keep following it until you cross a bridge. Enter the room across the bridge, in which you will encounter a Living Jar along with a Putrid Corpse. The room will be filled with numerous cages. On the northern side of the room, you'll find another room with three cages. On a dead body by the middle cage, you can pick up x1 Prattling Pate Lamentation . Gaol Upper Level Open the locked gate to get inside a room with a ladder and x1 Frozen Maggot that you can pick up. Climb down the ladder, and you will arrive in an area covered in ice. Living Jars will be running around the place, which you can easily deal with as they die in a few hits. You can also pick up numerous Frozen Maggots in the area, as they are scattered all around the area. There are four rooms in the area that you can enter. In the room closest to the entrance, on the eastern side, you can pick up x1 Chilling Perfume Bottle . The second room will be the initially closed, but you can open the gate without any key. The room will contain a ladder going down, which will be useful later on. The third room will be the only room that is located a bit higher than the other rooms, requiring you to make a few small jumps. Lastly, in the northernmost room, you will find Living Jars around the room along with a locked gate on the northwestern corner of the room. There will also be a hole near the entrance that leads to loot. Loot Detour and Navigating the Place Near the entrance of the third room, you will encounter a Living Jar along with a Putrid Corpse patrolling the nearby room. Head inside the area that seems to be a jail area, onto another room on the eastern side. The cells couldn't be opened, so keep heading east. In the second room, the floor will collapse, making you fall into an area in which you will be surrounded by Putrid Corpses. Go through the doorway, then keep following the path. You'll see a Putrid Corpse sitting on a cliff along the way. Head up the stairs to proceed further into Lamenter's Gaol. In the middle of the stairs, there will be a room on its landing. Enter the room then keep following its path, leading you to a room containing two Putrid Corpses and a dead body that you can loot for x1 Call of Tibia . Head back out the room, then continue walking up the stairs. There will be another landing with a Putrid Corpse hiding behind the corner. A room will be on the northern side of the landing. The room leads to an area overlooking the room filled with Living Jars. Retrieving the Gaol Lower Level Key Go down the slope, then defeat all the Living Jars in the area to freely explore it. On a structure made out of piled-up remains, you can pick up a Hefty Cracked Pot on top of it in the middle of small Living Jars holding hands. You can follow a path going southwest of the room, revealing just how big the whole area is. You can pick up x6 Living Jar Shard from a body on the southwestern corner of the area. A chest will be in the middle of the southwestern section part of the room, which you can acquire the Gaol Lower Level Key from when opening it. After acquiring the key, return to the stairs, then keep going up. After obtaining the Gaol Lower Level Key , return to the room where you got the Call of Tibia from, but do not enter it. On the southern wall near the doorway to the room is an illusory wall that leads to a locked gate. Use the Gaol Lower Level Key on the locked gate, then enter the room. In this room, you can find a Shadow Realm Rune [4] and the Lamenting Visage torch . Head out the room by following the path going north. When you get to the top of the stairs, enter the room. A Living Jar is hiding on the left side which can attack you by surprise if you aren't aware of it. Keep following the path, going through the doorway on the west side. If you jump down to the room, it will lead you back to the northernmost room. Head out of the room, then keep exploring the area containing many rooms if you haven't done that. More Loot Detour If you want to clear the area, jump down the hole near the entrance of the frozen room. After jumping, you'll find x2 Innard Meat from a dead body nearby. Follow the path going west. You will arrive in a dark area containing two Giant Rats . It's a dark area, so it is advisable to use a torch for this part. After dealing with the rats, follow the path going west, heading deeper into Lamenter's Gaol. You will encounter more Giant Rats in this area, which you deal with easily. In this room, there will be two paths that you can take. The path on the right will have a ladder going up, but two giant rats will be in the area. The ladder going up will lead you back to the frozen area with many rooms. The left path heads deeper into Lamenter's Gaol, leading you into a room with Giant Rats. You can also pick up the Clarifying Horn Charm +2 from a body near the blocked off path. The area being blocked is the one where you retrieved the Gaol Lower Level Key earlier. To make your way back, go back to the tunnel where you came from. The path will then fork, a left and a right path. The right path leads to where you came from. The left path will be the one that leads back to the frozen room, as it leads you back to the ladder room you found earlier. Facing The Lamenter Make your way back to the frozen room by following the path, then head to the northernmost room filled with jars. You can use the Gaol Lower Level Key to open the locked door. Once you have unlocked the door, go down the ladder. You will see a boss fog directly in front of you. Prepare yourself for combat, as you will be facing the boss of this area, the Lamenter . The Lamenter is a boss that is smaller than the usual bosses you encounter in this game. The Lamenter is an agile boss that relies on the use of its clones to deceive and confuse the player. Its clones will die in one hit, but hitting the clones will not damage the real Lamenter. Here is an in-depth guide for defeating the Lamenter . After defeating the Lamenter , you will receive the Lamenter's Mask helm. The exit will be located on the southeastern side of the room. See the next tab for the Scaduview Walkthrough. Click here to return to the tab selection. Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Scaduview DESCRIPTION HERE Teleport to Shadow Keep, Back Gate - Site of Grace Defeat Commander Gaius to access Scaduview Use the Scaduview - Site of Grace after defeating the boss Go to Albinauric's Shack Head north to Scadutree Chalice and get the x5 Scadutree Fragment NOTE : This area is only accessible after you have completed the Shadow Keep - Church District exploration. Make sure to read the full Shadow Keep (Part 1) to know how to reach this location. After exploring Charo's Hidden Grave and clearing Lamenter's Gaol , you will now teleport to Shadow Keep, Back Gate - Site of Grace to advance your game. Face north and go through the archway to fight Commander Gaius . You can view this page to read a comprehensive guide on how to defeat the boss. Use the newly-spawned Scaduview - Site of Grace and from here, head through the archway on the north. Keep following the path north until you see a broken-down house on the west of the path. Approach it, and you will be at the Albinauric's Shack. Albinauric's Shack From the Scaduview Site of Grace, head through the archway on the north. Keep following the path north until you see a broken-down house on the west of the path. Approach it, and you will be at the Albinauric's Shack. An Albinauric Wolfback Archer will be stationed in the Albinauric Shack. Once you have defeated the Albinauric Wolfback Archer, you can loot it to receive Gaius's Greaves . Head inside the shack to obtain the only item there, a Sharpshot Talisman . Return to the path going north, and you will see a big wall structure with an archway in the middle. Go through the archway in the middle, and you will be in Scadutree Chalice. In Scadutree Chalice, there will be 6 items on the ground that you can pick up. There are x5 Scadutree Fragments and a Blessed Bone Shard by the giant chalice. That's all there is in Scaduview for this tab. Continue reading the next one to enter Hinterlands in Scaduview (located east of where you fought Commander Gaius . See the next tab for the Hinterlands (Scaduview) Walkthrough. Click here to return to the tab selection. Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Hinterlands Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree - Hinterlands (continuing the quest of Count Ymir and Jolan) Reveal the entrance to Hinterlands through the Statue of Marika in Shadow Keep, Back Gate (This is part of the Finger Ruins Questline that includes Count Ymir and Jolan ) Defeat Tree Sentinel Explore Shaman Village Cross the bridge and use Hinterland Bridge - Site of Grace NOTE : You can only enter this area after you have obtained the O Mother (Gesture) near Bonny Village in Scadu Altus . This exploration picks up from the Shadow Keep (Church District exploration) and will continue from the Shadow Keep, Back Gate - Site of Grace. Teleport there and follow this guide to help you explore Scaduview and reach the Hinterlands while progressing the quests related to Finger Ruins, Count Ymir , and Jolan . How to Access Hinterlands Fast travel to the Shadow Keep, Back Gate Site of Grace , facing the entrance of the structure, go left and you will find a Summoning Pool that you can activate and a room you can go into. Head into the room, on the left is a message that reads "Have mercy, For the spirited-away shamans." and straight ahead you can pick up the Scadutree Fragment at the altar. At the altar, you will need to perform the O Mother Gesture in front of the altar to trigger it to move. Go through the hidden tunnel and you will find yourself at the Hinterlands. You can activate the Site of Grace as soon as you exit the tunnel and go down the steps. To begin exploring, you will head to Shaman Village. From the Site of Grace, follow the main path on your right and as you turn here, near the ramp, you will encounter a Tree Sentinel. This is a field boss that you can run away from if you can get far enough. You can ride Torrent inside this location so take advantage of that if you don't want to defeat this boss. Head up the ramp to the east and keep going until the Shaman Village flashes on your screen. Once you cross the bridge entering the village, head straight through the garden of flowers, and you'll find a Minor Erdtree plant in the middle of the garden, specifically illuminated by sunlight. After looting the Minor Erdtree, head up the hill to the left where there are abandoned structures, and turn right towards the cliff overlooking an abandoned house below. By the edge of the cliff, you'll find Marika's Rune . Afterward, continue up the hill to see more abandoned structures. On the right side of the area, you'll find a large tree with an open trunk. Inside this tree trunk, you can loot a corpse to obtain the Golden Braid . When you're done here, head back down the ramp where you encountered the Tree Sentinel. This time, head northeast and turn right as you go down the ramp. There's another Tree Sentinel here that you can choose to fight or run away from. Continue ahead and go past the bridge. Use the Hinterlands Bridge - Site of Grace before proceeding. Finger Ruins of Dheo Head east and continue the path facing the withered tree. After a short while of riding, you can see the Fingestone Hill - Site of Grace. Activate it, then continue traveling in the eastern direction and the Finger Ruins of Dheo will come into view. This area is covered with thick fog and can become difficult to navigate at night. You can pass the time to make navigating easier. Head south until you reach the end. You can interact with the bell and you will be granted the Cerulean Seed Talisman +1 . When you're done here, you will return to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and speak to Count Ymir and he will give you the Ruins Map (3rd) . IMPORTANT : The remaining section of this guide will tell you how to complete the questline of Count Ymir and Jolan, which takes place in the Finger Ruins of Miyr . Read below to find out more so you can get the best results of their quests. Return to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr With the third map, make sure to rest at a grace somewhere else and then fast-travel to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr so Count Ymir will not be there. Make your way over to the throne you once met Count Ymir on. This time, you can examine the throne. Interact with it to see it slide back and reveal a rope ladder, take the ladder down to reach the Finger Ruins of Miyr . Finger Ruins of Miyr under the Cathedral Once you head down, an NPC invader Swordhand of Night Anna will appear. Defeat her and you will be granted the Claws of Night . You will be able to find a few Finger Mimics scattered around the area, other than that, you can find the Finger-Weaver's Cookbook (2) on a body on the lower left walkway of the path. Nearing the bell, you can interact with the Summoning Pool to activate it and then interact with the hanging bell to teleport you to the Metyr, Mother of Fingers arena. Once you Defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers you will be granted 420,000 Runes, and the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers . You can then fast-travel back to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and head back to the throne and interact with it once more to encounter another NPC invader named Swordhand of Night Jolan . Defeat her and you will have to face Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers . This is when Count Ymir borrows the powers of Metyr to fight you. Defeat her and you will be granted the High Priest Set that comes with the High Priest Hat , High Priest Robe , High Priest Gloves , and High Priest Undergarments , as well as Ymir's Bell Bearing and the Maternal Staff . Once you've successfully defeated both, rest at the Site of Grace and return to Jolan's initial spot to find her sitting on the ground against the pillar. As you approach Jolan, she will tell you she's losing her vision, and can't see the sky or the stars. You have 2 options for what item you want to give: Iris of Grace : Giving this item will turn Jolan into Swordhand of Night Jolan . Iris of Occultation : Giving this item will make Jolan pass quietly and they will drop the Sword of Night , thus ending her questline. IMPORTANT : Giving her the Iris of Grace will continue her questline where you can combine the ash with another to make it more powerful. You may only give her either the Iris of Occultation or the Iris of Grace to obtain only one reward per playthrough. To continue Jolan's questline, you need to return to Hinterlands, go to Shaman Village , and go to the very top of Rabbath's Rise. Look for a pathway at the back of the village, and travel down the cliffside, leading to a secret top part of Rabbath's Rise. Here you will find her puppet body, where you will be asked to combine the spirits together, claiming the Jolan and Anna Spirit Summon. NOTE : If you don't have these required items yet, read below if you want to find out where you can get Iris of Occultation and Iris of Grace. Iris of Occultation locations: Acquired as an item drop from defeating a Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit located in this area after you drain the flood in the Church District. [ See Shadow of the Erdtree Map ] Acquired as an item drop from a Lesser Omenkiller . Drop down the well in the main arena of Fort of Reprimand . The enemy will ambush you there among some items. [ See Shadow of the Erdtree Map ] Iris of Grace locations: Can be looted at the Specimen Storehouse of the Shadow Keep . [ See Shadow of the Erdtree Map ] Can be found at the base of the headless statue of Marika in the building west of the Sunken Chapel. Drain the water in the church district, and follow the path of the Tree-Worship Passage to find the statue there. [ See Shadow of the Erdtree Map ] See the next tab for the Jagged Peak Walkthrough. Click here to return to the tab selection. Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Jagged Peak Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree - Navigating Jagged Peak From the Dragon's Pit Terminus - Site of Grace, travel to Foot of Jagged Peak - Site of Grace and defeat the 2 Jagged Peak Drake Talk to Igon and receive Igon's Furled Finger Fight Ancient Dragon's Senessax Summon Igon to defeat Bayle The Dread Return to Igon's location near Foot of the Jagged Peak where you fought the 2 Dragons Return to Dragon Communion Priestess Head out to the Foot of the Jagged Peak by returning to where you fought the first dragon, but this time, you will head north and pass through the pillars. This will take you to the cliff of the mountain. Use the Spiritspring at the end of this path, then veer right and cross the bridge. Activate the Foot of the Jagged Peak site of grace here before proceeding. This is very important because you will be fighting a boss in the next area. This is where you will respawn if you die during the fight. Next, continue up ahead until you reach the boss arena. You will be fighting another Jagged Peak Drake , but this time, there will be two of them. After this fight, you will hear the voice of Igon nearby. Locate him towards the east and head towards the area where the red smoke is thick. Talk to him there and exhaust his dialogues. He will ask you to summon him and let him join you in the fight against Bayle the Dread . You will receive Igon's Furled Finger . From here, take the Spiritspring behind him, and another one at the next level. On the third level, you will see the entrance to the cave of the next dragon. Go inside the cave and watch out for the rolling boulders here. You can avoid it by going to the right area of the cave, and then crossing to the left as soon as the boulder rolls down. Before crossing, you also need to pay attention to an item on your right at the end and pick up the Scadutree Fragment here. Once you make it to the left side of the room, you will reach the arena of another boss. You will be fighting Ancient Dragon Senessax . After defeating this boss, go up the north exit where you will see the remains of other dragons on the ground. This serves as your guide that you are headed to the right place. Outside this area, activate the Jagged Peak Mountainside - Site of Grace. Then, head to the top of the mountain by heading southwest. You will see the dragon remains here and keep following it. There are also lightning effects that will occasionally strike. Then, use the Spiritspring and continue going to the south. Stick to the wall here to your left and use another Spiritspring . You will find yourself at a level with multiple dragon remains and a small cave entrance in front of you. Go inside and pick up the Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone on the right side, then walk over to your left and use another Spiritspring at the end. Use the Site of Grace at the top and this is the one that you will be using in case you die during the boss fight. (Beware: You probably will). Go towards the small opening here and once you enter the arena, Bayle the Dread will land once you are inside. Now, the key to completing Igon is to summon him here. He can't be summoned from the outside but you need to locate his summon sign inside the arena after this boss fight is triggered. After defeating this boss, return to Igon's last location where you fought the two Jagged Peak Drake . [ See the SOTE Elden Ring DLC Map ] He will drop his items that you can loot: Igon's Greatbow Igon's Helm Igon's Armor Igon's Gauntlets Igon's Loincloth Igon's Bell Bearing Once you have collected these items, go to the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion. Teleport to the site of grace that you previously used. The Dragon Communion Priestess has vanished and will leave the following items behind: Priestess Heart Flowerstone Gavel NOTE : There is an alternate ending for this NPC quest, but there are some requirements to meet before your fight with Bayle. The following requirements are: Meet Thiollier before Moore leaves the Main Gate Cross Site of Grace Speak to Moore and receive the Black Syrup from Thiollier Give Thiollier the Black Syrup in exchange for Thiollier's Concoction After you have met all these requirements, you will need to see the Dragon Communion Priestess at night. She will be seen speaking with Lord Placidusax. You can speak to her and give her Thiollier's Concoction . (IF GIVEN THE CONCOCTION SHE WILL NOT DROP THE PRIESTESS HEART OR THE GAVEL) If you give her Thiollier's Concoction she will fall asleep, wait 1 full day and she will wake up and express disappointment that she had succumbed to slumber. After defeating Bayle, return to her and she will give you the Dragonbolt of Florissax Incantation. Then if you confess that it was you that put her to sleep she will pledge to follow you and you will be given the Ancient Dragon Florissax Spirit Ashes. See the next tab for the Shadow Keep Depths (Recluse River) Walkthrough. Click here to return to the tab selection. Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Shadow Keep Depths (Main Gate to Recluse River) Entering Shadow Keep to Main Gate to gain access to Recluse River and Eastern Scadu Altus Teleport to Highroad Cross - Site of Grace Head north and enter Shadow Keep through the Main Gate (defeat the Furnace Golem if you haven't) Fight Golden Hippopotamus Exit through the northeast and make your way around this section to unlock the shortcut back to the Main Gate Plaza - Site of Grace ( NOTE : It is recommended to help Hornsent in this fight and use the gold summon sign since you can encounter Hornsent later on to get his items. You can earn additional rewards if you assist Hornsent to defeat Leda: Ash of War: Swift Slash and Leda's Rune .) Head back out through the southeast and do the Hornsent vs Leda fight Get Domain of Dragons Painting Reveal the Illusory Wall and ride the coffin Use the Castle Watering Hole - Site of Grace (explore here later) Eliminate the Furnace Golem Explore the Ruins of Unte Reach Village of Flies Make your way to Eastern Nameless Mausoleum and defeat Rakshasa Complete Darklight Catacombs Defeat Jori, Elder Inquisitor , and go through the new area NOTE : This portion of the Game Progress Route will guide you on how to reach the area under Shadow Keep and explore the path to Recluses' River that will let you access the following locations: Ruins of Unte , Eastern Nameless Mausoleum and Darklight Catacombs in the Eastern Scadu Altus. IMPORTANT : Needle Knight Leda and Hornest questline may get bricked if you accidentally enter the main boss in Shadow Keep . Make sure to read this guide to avoid canceling quests unintentionally. Shadow Keep (Entering through the Main Gate) The main entrance of the Shadow Keep is pretty linear, as you can follow the path directly from Castle Ensis leading to the main entrance of the Shadow Keep. Along the path, you will encounter Messmer Soldiers in encampments, so tread carefully. By the eastern section of the keep's outer walls, you can loot a fallen Furnace Golem for x1 Furnace Visage . Nearby, you can find a tent containing a corpse with x1 Furnace Keeper's Note . Return to the path, and you will find a big archway to a room containing a lift. This will take you to the Shadow Keep Main Gate Site of Grace [ See Elden Ring Map ]. When you arrive at the top of the lift, activate the Site of Grace. The area ahead of it is a boss room. Once you are ready to fight it, enter the room and you will encounter the Golden Hippopotamus . Its attacks have a deceptively big hit box, using mostly its head to attack. For more guides and strategies on how to defeat the boss, you can visit this page. After defeating the Golden Hippopotamus, it will drop x2 Scadutree Fragment and the Aspects of the Crucible: Thorns incantation. Defeating the Golden Hippopotamus will give you access to the Main Plaza of the Shadow Keep, allowing you to explore the whole area. The Main Gate Plaza Site of Grace [ See Elden Ring Map ] will be unlocked after the boss fight, so you can activate it now. The Main Plaza and Boss Fight After defeating the Golden Hippopotamus , you can head to the western archway to continue heading deeper into the Shadow Keep. Follow the path, and you will encounter two Messmer Soldiers overlooking the ledge on your left. After defeating them, pick up the Festive Grease from a corpse, and you'll encounter another Messmer Soldier going down the stairs. In the middle of the stairs, you can find a room with two more Messmer Soldiers along with a corpse that you can loot for x6 Smithing Stone [1] . You can find another room connected to this room on the right side, which contains two more Messmer Soldiers along with a Black Knight . On the dead body by the south side of the room, you can pick up the dagger Main-gauche . Afterwards, head back out the stairs on the west, then keep going up. You will encounter two Messmer Soldiers looking over the ledge on the left with a corpse that you can loot for x7 Redflesh Mushroom , and two more Messmer Soldiers on the right. After defeating the Messmer Soldiers, head up the stairs again to find another room. There will be three Black Knights inside the room; one wielding a hammer and greatshield , the second one using a greatbow , and the third one wielding a twinblade . You can deal with the first Black Knight by dragging him outside of the room to where you came from, then you can deal with the other two easily inside the room. On the opening on the south wall of the room, you can pick up x1 Golden Vow from corpse hanging by the ledge and x1 Shadow Realm Rune [6] from a body near the archway on the east. Exploring the Plaza As you head out of the room, you can drop down from the bridge on the left side, and you'll find x5 Smithing Stone [5] from a dead body. Continue heading south, and you will see a golden tree. Directly beside it, you can pick up the Talisman of Lord's Bestowal . On the room south of the tree, you can pick up x2 Smithing Stone [8] from a dead body on the ledge northwest of the room. Northwest of the plaza, you can find a Black Knight facing a dead body with an item. Defeat the Black Knight, then pick up the x3 Golden Vow on the dead body. You can get back up by entering the room east of the corpse, which will contain a Messmer Soldier and a Black Knight. A ladder room will be on the eastern side, which leads you back to the room with the three Black Knights that you just fought. Shortcut access back to Main Plaza Grace After opening the door back to the room, head east again through the archway to continue progressing through the Shadow Keep. On the northeastern side, which is a dead-end, you can loot a body for x1 Holyproof Pickled Liver . Keep following the path going to the southeast, and you'll encounter Shadow Militiamen by the boats. By the stairs heading up, you can pick up x1 Messmerfire Grease from the dead body lying on the stairs. South of it, you can find a ramp going down, in which you will encounter more Shadow Militiamen. Open the double door, which leads you back to the Main Gate Plaza Site of Grace. Obtain Domain of Dragons Painting From the Main Gate Plaza - Site of Grace, exit through the door while facing Southeast. This will take you to an area with Satyr enemies. Outside, go up the ramp and make a right to the burning boats. Then, use the ladder on the left side to go down near a waterfall to the left. Walk towards the waterfall to reveal a room here. Take the ladder going down and go through the door to your left. You will see the Domain of Dragons Painting here. Interact with it, then pay attention to the wall behind you. Path to Ruins of Unte and Eastern Scadu Altus Dungeons This blank wall is a secret passage and you can attack it to reveal a new area. This will lead you to an area beneath Eastern Scadu Altus region and allows you to reach Eastern Nameless Mausoleum and Darklight Catacombs . To continue, go through the secret room and follow the stream of water. Go down the steps and turn left. You will see a coffin at the edge here. Rest in the coffin to travel to a new location. After the short cutscene plays you will arrive at a new location. Go through the door then activate the Castle Watering Hole - Site of Grace left of the doorway. Then, summon Torrent and ride southeast here. You will come across a Furnace Golem here and it's up to you if you want to defeat it. You will arrive at Ruins of Unte, a new area that you can explore. When you first arrive at the Ruins of Unte, you'll encounter one Furnace Golem that rises when you approach it [ See Shadow of the Erdtree Map ]. Defeating this Furnace Golem drops the Oil-Soaked Tear crystal tear and a Furnace Visage . Defeat it and head toward the ruins and you'll notice one "dead" or "unlit" Furnace Golem blocking the ruins' entrance. Head to the east side and use your mount to jump over the rubble and remains of the buildings until you reach the balcony overlooking the "dead" Furnace Golem. To wake up the Golem, you need to have a Hefty Furnace Pot in your inventory, equip it, and throw it on its head. A Hefty Furnace Pot can be crafted with the following materials: x1 Redflesh Mushroom , x1 Ember of Messmer , and x1 Furnace Visage . The recipe to learn how to craft this item requires the player to acquire the Greater Potentate's Cookbook (2) item which can be looted from a dead body at the Run-Down Traveler's Rest in Gravesite Plain [ See Shadow of the Erdtree Map ]. Defeating this awakened Furnace Golem drops the x1 Bloodsucking Cracked Tear and x1 Furnace Visage . From the Castle Watering Hole - Site of Grace, travel south and you will stick to the mountain side on your left. Make sure to pay attention to the gaps on the platform here. Once the path to the left side ends, jump over to the other side. This time, you will stick to the mountainside to the right. From here, you can activate the Recluses' River Downstream - Site of Grace. This is important because you will be returning to this location to reach the Southern Shore . Next, you will go down some platforms near this Site of Grace. When you reach the river level, head north and turn right until you reach the end where you'll find the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum and the Darklight Catacombs . By the entrance, there is a Summoning Pool or effigy for players to use for co-op. There is also a Stake of Marika that you can use to respawn by the entrance of the mausoleum in case you die. As mentioned, the location is where you'll fight against a mini-boss, so make preparations before you pass through the mist. For guides and strategies on how to defeat the boss, please visit the Rakshasa boss page. Defeating this mini-boss rewards the player with the following items: Rakshasa Set Rakshasa's Great Katana Village of Flies NOTE : You can reach this area by traveling from the Castle Watering Hole - Site of Grace, or if you have activated the Recluses' River Downstream - Site of Grace, you can teleport there and start your path from the next paragraph. From the Castle Watering Hole - Site of Grace, you will come across a Furnace Golem next to the the ruins and you can ignore it and follow the stream. Head southwest and scale the wall on your left side. You will be able to activate the Recluses' River Upstream Site of Grace here. Continue scaling the wall and occasionally jumping between platforms. Pay attention to the flooring here as a gap separates some. When you reach the end, cross to the right side and still, continue heading towards the southern direction. From here, flies will now start attacking you. This is when a small village will come into view on the eastern side. To get there, you first need to get past it, come around, and drop to the platform ahead of you. You will be able to activate and rest at the Recluses' River Downstream - Site of Grace here. After activating this site, you will jump down and continue navigating ahead. You will know that you are in the right area if there are Giant Flies on your path. As you reach the ground level, a Curseblade will attack you. Watch out because this fight can be difficult because the other Giant Flies will also attack you here. After the fight, explore the western direction and you will find a Revered Spirit Ash on the small altar. Then, go around it and jump up the stones to reach the small, elevated area. You can pick up a Silver Horn Tender here found next to destroyed pots and corpses. Then, go to the top part of the village, and loot the Man-Fly Ashes guarded by two Shadow Undead and several Man-Fly enemies. That wraps up the quick exploration of Village of Flies and you will now head to Darklight Catacombs where your goal is to defeat Jori, Elder Inquisitor and activate the site of grace that spawns after the fight. This allows you to teleport here later when you are ready to explore Abyssal Woods (which is recommended after clearing Jagged Peak ). Darklight Catacombs The Darklight Catacombs is located south of the Scadu Altus region, directly south of the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum . To get there, go to the Recluses' River Downstream Site of Grace [ See Elden Ring Map ], then go traverse the cliffs going south. As you get to the bottom, keep going south. By going in this direction, you will stumble upon the door leading to the Darklight Catacombs. Open the door to gain access inside the catacombs. Once you are inside the Darklight Catacombs, follow the path leading to a lift. After arriving at the bottom, you can activate the Darklight Catacombs Site of Grace [ See Elden Ring Map ]. After activating the Site of Grace, head north to pick up x1 Grave Glovewort [5] . A lionhead Imp will jump on you as you approach the item, so take caution. Once you have picked up the Grave Glovewort, go to the eastern hall right before picking up the loot. Grab x1 Yellow Fulgurbloom right as you head down the path. Turn left, and you'll find another path going down, with x1 Yellow Fulgurbloom in the middle of the stairs. You will arrive on a ledge area with two Fanged Imps. Defeat the enemies, then drop down the ledge or walk down the ramp. Immediately on the west of where you dropped is a passageway leading to a lever that will turn on the lights when pulled. Go back to where you dropped, then head southeast, passing through the archway. As you turn the corner to the archway, a Bigmouth Imp will attack you. In the room overlooking the lit area, you can drop from the railings onto a ledge, then drop from the broken section of the ledge to a room with a chest containing the Viridian Amber Medallion +3 . Afterwards, drop down to a bridge. The room on the south connecting to the bridge contains x1 Grave Glovewort [1] on the east side, and x2 Yellow Fulgurbloom right by the western wall. After clearing the area, follow the path going north leading to another lift. Use the lift to go down. Follow the path north, going through the ramp on the right side to progress. A Fanged Imp will be waiting for you at the bottom of the ramp. Keep heading north, and you'll find x1 Yellow Fulgurbloom along with a bigmouth Imp opposite of it. After dealing with the imp, go back a few steps and you'll see a ladder going up. Climb the ladder, then turn right through the tight passageway, dropping to a room with a lever. Pull the lever, and you will activate the lights in another area. By the lever, you can drop down safely into a staircase below containing x4 Thin Beast Bones . Follow the path going up the stairs. Once you have arrived at the top of the second set of stairs, look down by the opening, then drop down to the ledge. Follow the ledge going west, then climb up the ladder in the corner. In front of you, you can pick up x1 Shadow Realm Rune [5] from a corpse, and you will encounter an Inquisitor. You can safely drop to the room below with a body that has x1 Ghost Glovewort [2] . A Fanged Imp will attack you from behind after dropping. You can exit through the archway to the east. You'll be back in the area where you climbed up a ladder to the lever room. You'll find a broken section of the railings. Drop down to the ledge bellow it, and you'll find a hallway with an Inquisitor on the southeastern corner. In this hallway, you can obtain the Death Knight Set from a dead body by the ledge on the north. South of the hallway, you can find an opening with a ladder going down. Climb down the ladder then head east through the archway. On your left, you'll find x1 Ghost Glovewort [9] . On your right, a Inquisitor will be attacking you. Defeat the Inquisitor, then drop down the ledge. After dropping down, you can pick up x1 Yellow Fulgurbloom just where you dropped. Go east, then go through the archway going down, leading you to another lift. After arriving at the bottom of the lift, keep heading east. You will encounter a giant Bigmouth Imp which shoots fireballs towards you. Run through it, then turn left to head north. There will be a section here that has a pillar that can serve as a safe spot for you. As you are in the safe spot, a Fanged Imp will approach you. After dealing with the Fanged Imp, sprint to the area where it came from, then pull the lever in the room. Afterwards, kill the giant Bigmouth Imp , then defeat the Fanged Imp that spawns after it. NOTE : Do not kill the Giant Bigmouth Imp before pulling the lever, or else the Great Ghost Glovewort that it drops will be stuck on the platform. Go back to where you dropped, and you can pick up x2 Yellow Fulgurbloom and x1 Ghost Glovewort [8] . Afterwards, head to the pathway that the giant Bigmouth imp was blocking, then enter the room to loot a chest containing x1 Bigmouth Imp Ashes . Head up the stairs on the eastern wall, then keep heading east through the hall. You will encounter a Fanged Imp at the end of the hallway. You can safely drop, then head north. In the northernmost wall, you can pick up x1 Grave Glovewort [4] from a dead body. Head back south going down the ramps, and you'll find another lift which leads you to a boss fog. Once you head inside the boss fog, you will encounter Jori, Elder Inquisitor . For a more detailed guide on how to defeat Jori, Elder Inquisitor , you can visit this page. After defeating Jori, Elder Inquisitor, you will obtain the Barbed Staff-Spear and the Forsaken Graveyard Site of Grace [ See Elden Ring Map ] will be unlocked. When you're done here, you will now head to the Abyss by entering through the new are you just unlocked. See the next tab for the Abyssal Woods. Click here to return to the tab selection. Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Abyss Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree - Navigating Abyssal Woods Activate Woodlands Trail - Site of Grace Obtain Map: Abyss Reach Abandoned Church Return to Woodlands Trail, then make your way to Abyssal Woods - Site of Grace Explore Midra's Manse NOTE : The Abyssal Woods can be accessed after defeating the boss of the Darklight Catacombs . You can follow the path going south to get to the Abyssal Woods region. If you haven't reached this location, you can follow the #15 of the Game Progress Route or Shadow Keep Underground (Main Gate and Recluse River ) and follow the guide to clear Darklight Catacombs. After defeating Jori, Elder Inquisitor , you will unlock an entrance to the Abyssal Woods. First, activate the Forsaken Graveyard - Site of Grace that spawned after the fight then head through the archway and head south. NOTE : Down here, Torrent can't be summoned because it is terrified, and you will be walking on foot. Continue heading south until you see another Site of Grace as soon as you formally enter the region. You can see it right in front of the thick tree. Use the Woodlands Trail - Site of Grace. From there, head south and follow the dirt path. You will pass through some creatures here and skeleton enemies. As soon as you see the elevated thick tree, turn left and you will be heading east this time. You know that you are in the right place if you can spot the church-like structure from a distance. Along the trail, you will encounter a hostile NPC, the Madding Hand (NPC) who drops the Madding Hand weapon if you kill the NPC. Continue along the path until you reach the pillar and the Abandoned Church. The map is right in front of this building so make sure to pick up Map: Abyss first. This will help you navigate the area easily. Abandoned Church Inside the abandoned church, you can find x2 Scadutree Fragment in front of the altar. Check the north side interior of the church to find a body sitting against the wall. Loot the corpse to acquire x1 Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle . Midra's Manse NOTE : The enemies there with the orange glowing heads cannot be damaged with normal weaponry so it's recommended to sneak when you come across them. Stick to the edges and crouch low until you get out of their zones. Return to the Woodland Trail - Site of Grace and then face the west direction. Jump down the platform and follow the river here. Keep walking towards the west until you reach the Abyssal Woods - Site of Grace. Head north and go towards the tall archway at the far end. After the archway, face the western direction and keep walking. Watch out for the enemies patrolling here. At the end, you will see a waterfall and Divided Falls - Site of Grace. Backtrack a little and go under the bridge to the southeast. You can see 2 enemies here but you can try to fight them, or outrun them. Then, jump down and turn right. Look for a ramp to your left and climb it by jumping between the stones. Stick to the right wall and then jump down again. You will see a building in the distance to the south and this is the Midra's Manse. You will find the door here directly on your south if you stick to the right wall. As you enter the room, a voice can be heard asking you to leave. In this room, you can turn right to find a room with a dead body containing x1 Swollen Grape . The stairs going up will lead you to the Manse Hall Site of Grace [ See Elden Ring Map ]. The door on the west side of the hall will be locked, so hit the painting opposite of it to reveal a hidden hallway. Proceed through the hallway, and you will find a room on your left. Enter the room, then pick up x1 Torn Diary Page on a dead body. The room will be filled with Shadow Undead , which you can easily deal with as they die in one or two hits. You can then climb up the bookshelves through the southeastern corner of the room, then head to the tallest bookshelf to obtain x2 Swollen Grape . Head back out the hallway through either of the two doorways in the room. After heading out, you will encounter a Horned Warrior patrolling around the hallway. Once you have dealt with the Horned Warrior, you can follow the hallway going east, then going around the corner to find another room. Enter the room filled with Shadow Undead, along with a Shadow Undead above using the incantation The Flame of Frenzy on you. You can pick up x4 Thin Beast Bones on a body by the fireplace. Head to the archway leading to another room, and you will encounter another Horned Warrior patrolling the room. You can sneak past the Horned Warrior as its pathing will only be in the direction it is facing. Follow the room going southwest, and a Shadow Undead will be waiting for you around the corner. The Shadow Undead will try to get a jump on you, so attack it right as you are going around the corner. After dealing with the Shadow Undead, head to the room opposite of it, then pull the lever. After pulling the lever, follow the room on the east, hugging the wall, and you will find a ladder going up. You'll end up in a room with Shadow Undead scattered around. You can pick up x1 Shadow Realm Rune [6] from a dead body hanging by a beam. Head to the next room, which will be the balcony that the Shadow Undead using Flame of Frenzy on you is located. x3 Surging Frenzied Flame will be on the southwestern section of the balcony.
