text: Gowry | Elden Ring Wiki Home Wikis News Reviews Guides Forum Sign In Help Profile Following Account Preferences Premium Log Out Sign In Now World Information / NPCs + 493 79 … Visit Discord Create new page Edit History Recent Changes Rename Redirect Lock Unlock Permissions Javascript Tags Edit Open Graph Clear page cache Clear comments cache File Manager Page Manager Wiki Templates Comments Approval Wiki Settings Wiki Manager Delete Recent Changes New page File Manager Members Page Manager Settings Create Wiki Search Results Gowry | Elden Ring Wiki Gowry 賢者ゴーリー 「 ken·ja goーriー 」 Location Gowry's Shack , Caelid Role Elder Sage Voiced by Stephen Boxer Gowry (or Sage Gowry ) is an NPC in Elden Ring . Gowry is a once great Sage who wishes to cure the young Millicent from a rotting sickness. He can be found in his shack, Gowry's Shack within Caelid . Speaking with Gowry is required to complete Millicent's questline. See Gowry Lore The rotting sickness that afflicts Millicent has no cure. When the Erdtree flourished, even the demigods could not stave off its effects, despite their nigh godhood. Gowry's Location in Elden Ring Gowry can be found at Gowry's Shack located in eastern Caelid , just before reaching Sellia, Town of Sorcery . [ Map Link ] This NPC does not move This merchant can be fought If defeated, drops: Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing . Gowry Questline: How to complete Gowry's Quest Speak to Gowry in his shack to begin the questline involving him and Millicent . The walkthrough for this questline is on Millicent 's page. Beware of the Giant Dog found a short distance before the shack. Aggroing this dog and then speaking to Gowry may cause it to kill him. As you progress the questline, Gowry will provide the player a number of rewards: He will give the player Sellia's Secret after agreeing to find the Unalloyed Gold Needle After Millicent leaves Gowry's Shack, he will sell these spells: Glintstone Stars Night Shard Night Maiden's Mist After giving Millicent the Valkyrie's Prosthesis , Gowry will sell Pest Threads Purchasing it from him will prompt some dialogue from him and allow you to ask him about his interest in rot and Malenia . You will also be given the Desperate Prayer gesture . Once you have progressed Millicent's questline to the point that you can choose to invade Millicent or help her in battle, Gowry can be found crying in his shack. Ask him why he's crying, and he will ask you to kill Millicent, rather than help her in battle, as he wishes for her to become a flower. Assist Millicent: Upon returning to his shack, Gowry will be lamenting over Millicent's decision to remove the needle. Killing him at this point will not cause him to respawn, and he will drop Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing . Challenge Millicent: Upon returning to his shack, Gowry will be dead and you can also retrieve the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing . Elden Ring Gowry Shop Sells Price Glintstone Stars 3000 Night Shard 4000 Night Maiden's Mist 5000 Pest Threads 7500 Dialogue in Elden Ring: Gowry § Introduction ~ ( 初対面 ) Oh, a pleasure to see you. a pleasure indeed. I am Gowry. A great sage, in my day anyway. I'd hoped to ask favour, when one of your ilk came along. A strapping young Tarnished, able to cross the Scarlet swamp of Aeonia. Don't fret, I'll provide fine recompense. Should you accept.. I will teach you the secret of Sellia, the town you see there. [Accept] Ah, then you're willing to lend a hand, are you? I need your help to heal a certain young girl. Her name is Millicent. You will find her beyond Sellia, resting at the church atop the cliff, stricken by the rotting sickness. [Decline] Ah, my apologies. I rather got ahead of myself, didn't I. Well, no matter. I'm accustomed to waiting. But if you decide to hear my offer, whenever that may be, do come and speak with me again. I'll wait as long as it takes. [Talk after declining] Ah, changed your mind, have you? If you are willing to undertake my request, I'll gladly share with you the secret of Sellia, the town yonder. The rotting sickness that afflicts Millicent has no cure. When the Erdtree flourished, even the demigods could not stave off its effects, despite their nigh godhood. But Millicent's suffering can be ameliorated. For this, you are to find a certain needle. Seek the deep scarlet swamp of Aeonia, outside Sellia's bounds. The needle, made form unalloyed gold, is lost somewhere there. First you must find the unalloyed gold needle. It's hidden somewhere deep in the scarlet swamp of Aeonia. Then I will tell you as promised. The secret of the town of Sellia. § After acquiring the broken Unalloyed Gold Needle ~ 【無垢金の針】入手後 Ohh, you've found the unalloyed gold needle. As promised I've detailed the secret of Sellia right here. Go on, its yours. Now, let me have a look at the needle. [ Sellia's Secret ] § Talking with him after resting at a site of Grace, after giving him the broken Unalloyed Gold Needle ～ ( 無垢金の針を直した ) The needle is repaired. Now it will forestall the rotting sickness I'm sure. Will you give it to the girl, Millicent? I will reward you in kind. Millicent rests at the church atop the cliff, beyond Sellia, the town yonder. Tended to by the witless pests who worship her, or rather, her rotting sickness, as a god. A wretched fate indeed. The poor girl, she never wished for any of this. § After giving Millicent the repaired Unalloyed Gold Needle ~ Church of the Plague ～ ( ミリセントに【無垢金の針】を渡した ) Thank you kindly. For giving the needle to Millicent. Now, she too, can begin her journey. And stare her fate straight in the eye. You've been a saint, through and through. As thanks, I vow to impart to you my knowledge of the lost sorceries of the Sellians, descendants of the Eternal. Do you find it peculiar? That I would show such concern for the girl? Well, I'm the one who found her. A mere babe, in the swamp of Aeonia. She is one of my dear daughters. But the rotting sickness erodes one's memory. I doubt that she remembers the first thing about me. Oh, I must be getting old. I didn't always worry so much. § After Millicent has visited, and left, Gowry's Shack ~ ( ミリセントがゴーリのホロ家に訪ねて出て行って ) Oh, you noticed, did you? Indeed, Millicent did visit this hovel of a home. It seems the memories eaten away by the rotting sickness yet remain, but faintly. However, she has no need of me, any more. No, she must embark on her journey, and stare her fate in the eye. I mustn't impede. As I've aged, I've found the best way to aid the young... Is to be forgotten. Please make certain that little Millicent goes unharmed. Like her mother, she has the stuff to be a great warrior, but commands only one arm, and is yet preciously young. § After giving Millicent the Valkyrie Prosthesis ~ ( ミリセントに戦乙女の義手を渡した後 ) This is a wonderful development. Thank you for your kindness. Now Millicent may fully realise her true warrior's potential. Like her beautiful mother. Green and undeveloped, waiting to flower into magnificence. What a wondrous day that will be. In truth, before her, I'd never seen a bud of such superior quality. She might very well outshine her sisters. § After giving Millicent the Valkyrie Prosthesis , and purchasing the Pest Threads incantation ~ マレニアについて Do you have an interest in rot incantations? Then you might like to learn something of the history... of Malenia, goddess of scarlet rot. Queen Marika and her King Consort Radagon were blessed with twin demigods, and Malenia was one of them. She was born an Empyrean, carrying the scarlet rot. An Empyrean...is no mere demigod. In the age of the Elden Ring, and Queen Marika, the precious Empyrean was born. A new god to forge a new Order. Since Malenia fought Radahn, and the great scarlet flower blossomed in Aeonia, I have dedicated myself to her. And to the resplendence of the Order of Rot. The cycle of decay and rebirth. § After speaking to Millicent at the Prayer Room Site of Grace ～ ( 祈祷室でミリセントと会話後 ) The words of a true innocent, the dear girl. Well, perhaps this is just as it should be. Little Millicent, following in the steps of her mother, no matter what. This is their fate, after all. § Once you have the choice to help Millicent ; or invade her: ~ Near 'Drainage Channel' site of Grace [Why are you crying?] Oh it's just... I realised that I'd soon be saying my goodbyes to Millicent, and... My eyes began to well... She is to meet them very soon. Her sisters. And when she does, she'll be defeated, surely, and begin to flower. [Become a flower? (1)] Which is why... If you happen to be present for the girl's fight with her sisters, I ask that you side with the sisters and kill Millicent. It must be done by your hand; no other. Millicent trusts you, rather deeply in fact. Sever that trust. Nurtured by betrayal, her bud will flower most vividly. When Malenia ascends to godhood, Millicent too shall be reborn. As a scarlet valkyrie. [Become a flower? (2)] You can't tell me you don't wish to see it. The superior bud that is Millicent, becoming the finest of flowers? I beg of you, kill her. With your own two hands. § After assisting Millicent in the battle with her 4 sisters ... ～ ...and she pulls out the Unalloyed Gold Needle ～ ( お姉妹の4人と戦いで助力上げたの後 ) Millicent, my daughter. Why would you take out the needle? You were so close. So very close. To becoming the fairest of all flowers. Would you disown us too? As your Mother did? We children of the scarlet rot? Millicent... Malenia... Do you detest us, so utterly? Other "We shall meet again, you and I. There are countless pests to choose from." (First time killing Gowry) "We shall meet again. As many times as it takes. For you to understand." (Subsequent killing at Gowry's Shack after the first) "Have you taken the lesson, now? Killing me is an exercise in futility. All is well, provided you understand. Let's just pretend it never happened, shall we?" (Dialogue after talking to him at Gowry's Shack after he has respawned) After killing Millicent at the Church of Plague "O Millicent, my daughter... Who would prune your sapling flesh? Such...such cruel and vulgar violence..." "O Millicent... My most promising little bud..." Elden Ring Gowry Notes & Trivia Killing him at Gowry's Shack reveals the body to be a Kindred of Rot followed by dialogue from Gowry suggesting his actual body is elsewhere. When reloading the world he will have respawned. If you choose to assist Millicent rather than invade her, you may be locked out of getting the Flock's Canvas Talisman . Sometimes, Gowry cannot be killed and will continue to turn into the kindred of rot. It is not known if this is intentional or a bug. Sage Gowry Lore Lore Items Related to Sage Gowry Unalloyed Gold Needle An intricately crafted needle of unalloyed gold, snapped in half. A ritual implement crafted to ward away the meddling of outer gods, it is thought capable of forestalling the incurable rotting sickness. Sage Gowry has designs for this needle. Unalloyed Gold Needle An intricately crafted needle of unalloyed gold. Once snapped in half, it has been repaired by Sage Gowry. A ritual implement crafted to ward away the meddling of outer gods, it is thought capable of forestalling the incurable rotting sickness. "Now, all you need do is deliver the needle to Millicent, convalescing in the church atop the cliff just beyond Sellia." Sage Robe Thick burgundy robe. Attire of the wise sages who were deemed heretical. Evidence that the wearer was driven from town. Sellia's Secret Note given by Sage Gowry detailing the secret he promised. The Town of Sellia hides the source. Light three flames atop the candle towers to break the seal. Pest Threads Incantation of the servants of rot. Secretes countless sticky threads, launching them forwards. A technique of the pale pests who crawl through the lands afflicted by scarlet rot; the abandoned children of the goddess. "Do you have an interest in rot incantations?" Kindred of Rot's Exultation A talisman depicting the exultation of pests. Raises attack power when poisoning or rot occurs in the vicinity. "Rot for the scarlet goddess. O scarlet blossoms, flourish in distant lands, and return to us, the unwanted children." Millicent's Prosthesis Part of the golden prosthesis used by Millicent. The hand is locked into a fist that once raised a sword aloft. Boosts dexterity and raises attack power with successive attacks. The despair of sweet betrayal transformed Millicent from a mere bud into a magnificent flower. And one day, she will be reborn - as a beautiful scarlet valkyrie. Rotten Winged Sword Insignia A talisman depicting a raised prosthetic blade. An honor bestowed upon the valkyries who serve the goddess of rot. Greatly raises attack power with successive attacks. The Four sisters were born in the swamp of Aeonia, and came to the Haligtree under the aegis of Gowry. And yet, those buds were doomed to never blossom. Scarlet Aeonia Technique of Malenia, the Goddess of Rot. Creates a gigantic flower that blooms into an explosion of scarlet rot. Each time the scarlet flower blooms, Malenia's rot advances. It has bloomed twice already. With the third bloom, she will become a true goddess. Dialogue Related to Sage Gowry Millicent Something about this place felt familiar to me. So I decided to pay a visit, hoping to find someone here. But I've only found emptiness. Perhaps before my departure, I needed someone to say farewell to. I am of Malenia's blood. But in what capacity I know not. I could be sister, daughter, or an offshoot... Whatever the case though, I am certain of a kinship between us. But this is where things end. I pause to even tell you, but... I took out the needle myself. Tell whoever put you up to this. That if I am to flower into something other than myself, I would rather rot into nothingness as I am. text: Goldmask | Elden Ring Wiki Home Wikis News Reviews Guides Forum Sign In Help Profile Following Account Preferences Premium Log Out Sign In Now World Information / NPCs + 588 37 … Visit Discord Create new page Edit History Recent Changes Rename Redirect Lock Unlock Permissions Javascript Tags Edit Open Graph Clear page cache Clear comments cache File Manager Page Manager Wiki Templates Comments Approval Wiki Settings Wiki Manager Delete Recent Changes New page File Manager Members Page Manager Settings Create Wiki Search Results Goldmask | Elden Ring Wiki Goldmask Location Altus Plateau Leyndell, Royal Capital Mountaintops of the Giants Role Quest NPC Voiced by Ryan Morris Goldmask is a Tarnished NPC in Elden Ring . Goldmask can be found at various locations starting in Altus Plateau . He is also part of Brother Corhyn's questline, and is a staunch pursuer of Golden Order Fundamentalism . At each location, he does not move. See Goldmask Lore Do you know of the Noble Goldmask? Though he was but a Tarnished, living outside the Lands Between, he was a great scholar, who foresaw the coming guidance of Grace. - Brother Corhyn Goldmask Information in Elden Ring This NPC moves. If attacked, they will simply disappear. Attacking this NPC does not mark you as a sinner Goldmask Location in Elden Ring Goldmask can be found at in multiple locations: First found North in Altus Plateau region at the forest spanning greatbridge. [ Map Link ] After gaining access to Leyndell, Royal Capital , he relocates to the colosseum in Leyndell, Royal Capital . [ Map Link ] He then relocates to the Mountaintops of The Giants . His corpse can then be found near his original location at the bottom of the colosseum in the Ashen Capital . Goldmask Questline: How to complete Goldmask's Quest Goldmask is part of Brother Corhyn's Questline. Dialogue in Elden Ring: Goldmask This NPC has no dialogue other than "..." Elden Ring Goldmask Notes & Trivia Gives Mending Rune of Perfect Order in Leyndell, Ashen Capital at the end of Brother Corhyn's Questline. Head south-southwest from the Ashen Capital Site of Grace past the round staircase on your left and cross the tree log bridge, heading up the stairs to the south opposite the Giant Miranda Sprout . Goldmask's corpse will be uphill just around the bend, lying in light along the right wall. If you go back to his corpse after you get the Mending Rune of Perfect Order , he will drop Goldmask's Set (excluding the Radiant Gold Mask , which can be picked up in the Altus Plateau ). [ Map Link ] His voice actor, Ryan Morris, also voices Horace the Hushed from Dark Souls III and the Messengers from Bloodborne. Goldmask Lore Lore Items Related to Goldmask Goldmask's Rags Worn rags that just barely cover the body. Lord Goldmask felt no draw to the vain excess of clothing; what use is finery to one who seeks greater brilliance? Radiant Gold Mask A mask designed to resemble a blazing golden halo. Created and left behind by Lord Goldmask, a staunch pursuer of Golden Order fundamentalism. Strengthens Golden Order incantations. Its striking design represents both the brilliant inspiration that once shone upon him, and the vision of a ring that he will surely find at the end of his pursuit. "To you who seek to shine as I do, wear it well!" Order Healing One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. Used by hunters of Those Who Live in Death. Alleviates death blight buildup. The noble Goldmask lamented what had become of the hunters. How easy it is for learning and learnedness to be reduced to the ravings of fanatics; all the good and the great wanted, in their foolishness, was an absolute evil to contend with. Does such a notion exist in the fundamentals of Order? Law of Regression Incantation of the Golden Order fundamentalists. One of the key fundamentals. Heals all negative statuses, dispels special effects, and reveals mimicry in all its forms. The fundamentalists describe the Golden Order through the powers of regression and causality. Regression is the pull of meaning; that all things yearn eternally to converge. Law of Causality One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. One of the key fundamentals. Manifests a small ring of causality within that allows the caster to automatically retaliate upon receiving a certain number of blows. The fundamentalists describe the Golden Order through the powers of regression and causality. Causality is the pull between meanings; that which links all things in a chain of relation . Mending Rune of Perfect Order Rune discovered by the noble Goldmask. Used to restore the fractured Elden Ring when brandished by the Elden Lord. A rune of transcendental ideology which will attempt to perfect the Golden Order. The current imperfection of the Golden Order, or instability of ideology, can be blamed upon the fickleness of the gods no better than men. That is the fly in the ointment. Dialogue Related to Goldmask Brother Corhyn Though he was but a Tarnished, living outside the Lands Between, he was a great scholar, who foresaw the coming guidance of grace. And now, I hear he has come to the Lands Between alone, to contemplate the Golden Order... The Golden Order is founded on the principle that Marika is the one true god. However... The name of Marika's second husband, King Consort Radagon, also appeared... Who exactly was Radagon? The master is stumped. I've…been gripped by a terrifying thought. The rhythms and calculus of the master's finger... betray a suspicion of the holism of the Golden Order. A conceit, I am afraid, that cannot be overlooked. Only, if the master were true to the Golden Order, why would he think to breach this forbidden mount of fire? text: Brother Corhyn | Elden Ring Wiki Home Wikis News Reviews Guides Forum Sign In Help Profile Following Account Preferences Premium Log Out Sign In Now World Information / NPCs + 1.2k 152 … Visit Discord Create new page Edit History Recent Changes Rename Redirect Lock Unlock Permissions Javascript Tags Edit Open Graph Clear page cache Clear comments cache File Manager Page Manager Wiki Templates Comments Approval Wiki Settings Wiki Manager Delete Recent Changes New page File Manager Members Page Manager Settings Create Wiki Search Results Brother Corhyn | Elden Ring Wiki Brother Corhyn Location Roundtable Hold Role Merchant and Quest NPC Voiced by Samuel Barnett Brother Corhyn is a Tarnished NPC in Elden Ring . Brother Corhyn is a holy practitioner who will teach you practical faith-based Incantations in exchange for Runes . You will encounter him once you've reached the Roundtable Hold . Welcome to the Roundtable Hold. I'm Corhyn, a man of the cloth. I teach incantations, the strength granted us by the Two Fingers, and explore the secrets of the Golden Order. Brother Corhyn Location in Elden Ring Brother Corhyn can first be found at the main room in Roundtable Hold . After leaving Roundtable Hold he can be found on the Northern road from Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace in Altus Plateau . [ Map Link ] After informing him about the location of Goldmask , Corhyn will move to his location in Altus Plateau . [ Map Link ] After gaining access to Leyndell, Royal Capital he will move there together with Goldmask, outside the colosseum. [ Map Link ] After solving their predicament at Leyndell, he will move to the bridge south of the Stargazers' Ruins together with Goldmask. [ Map Link ] At the end of Corhyn's questline, he can be found at Leyndell, Ashen Capital . [ Map Link ] This NPC moves. This NPC can be fought If defeated drops: Corhyn's Bell Bearing Flail Corhyn's Robe Elden Ring Brother Corhyn Shop Item Name Item Type Purchase Value Availability Urgent Heal Incantations 1,000 Always Heal Incantations 1,500 Always Great Heal Incantations 9,000 Altus Plateau Cure Poison Incantations 1,000 Always Magic Fortification Incantations 3,500 Always Flame Fortification Incantations 3,000 Always Lightning Fortification Incantations 7,500 Altus Plateau Discus of Light Incantations 11,000 Near Goldmask Immutable Shield Incantations 13,000 Solve Riddle Rejection Incantations 1,500 Always Catch Flame Incantations 600 Always Flame Sling Incantations 800 Always O, Flame! Incantations 6,000 Requires Fire Monk's Prayerbook Surge, O Flame! Incantations 5,500 Requires Fire Monk's Prayerbook Black Flame Incantations 7,500 Requires Godskin Prayerbook Black Flame Blade Incantations 6,000 Requires Godskin Prayerbook Assassin's Approach Incantations 2,000 Requires Assassin's Prayerbook Darkness Incantations 3,500 Requires Assassin's Prayerbook Law of Regression Incantations 10,000 Requires Golden Order Principia Radagon's Rings of Light Incantations 7,500 Requires Golden Order Principia Brother Corhyn Questline: How to complete Brother Corhyn's Quest Brother Corhyn can first be met once the player is able to go to Roundtable Hold. He can be seen standing in the main room. After reaching Altus Plateau , Brother Corhyn will tell you he is going on a journey to find the Goldmask . After resting, he moves to Altus Plateau and increases the number of Incantations he knows. Corhyn will be standing on the road north of the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace, next to the monument where the Map (Altus Plateau) can be found. [ Map Link ] If you find Corhyn dead at any point in the questline, you can still complete the steps with Goldmask. On the north side of Altus Plateau, there is a large broken bridge. You can encounter Goldmask standing on the north section of the Forest-Spanning Great Bridge, south of East Windmill Pasture . Traveling north of the Bower of Bounty grace, you can use a Spirit Spring near the bridge to jump directly up to the Goldmask. Alternatively, use the waygate on the southern section of the Forest-Spanning Great Bridge, next to the Forest-Spanning Great Bridge Site of Grace. After speaking to the Goldmask, you can return to Corhyn and inform him of Goldmask's location. After resting, Corhyn moves to stand next to the Goldmask and adds new incantations to his stock. You can discuss Goldmask with him. After obtaining at least two Great Runes and gaining access to Leyndell, Corhyn and Goldmask move to the city Leyndell , and are found on a cliff east of the colosseum, contemplating a riddle. From the West Capital Ramparts Site of Grace, head overall south, along the balcony. The balcony will lead to a stone pathway, and upwards to the colosseum. Follow the path, dealing with the two Duelists along the way. From the top of the path, head left until you find the pair. Exhaust Corhyn's dialogue about Goldmask. [ Map Link ] Note that in order to progress his questline you need to solve this riddle before burning the Erdtree at Forge of the Giants (after Fire Giant boss fight), otherwise Corhyn will vanish and leave behind Corhyn's Bell Bearing in Leyndell. In addition, Goldmask will not be present. The solution is found west of the Erdtree Sanctuary Site of Grace, down an elevator and a set of stairs. A white message on the ground facing the statue mentions "Regression". You must stand on the message, facing the statue, and cast the Law of Regression incantation to solve the riddle. Touch the new message that appears, and report the secret to Goldmask and then exhaust Corhyn's dialogue. To acquire Law of Regression , find the Golden Order Principia book of incantations above Erdtree Sanctuary after defeating the golden shade of Godfrey . Head east, then double back onto the root to enter the sanctuary's second floor. From there, travel west to a roof with a broken window. The book can be found on a corpse sitting in a suspended stone chair above the center of the chamber. The incantation can be learned from Miriel or Corhyn for 10,000 runes. Casting Law of Regression requires 37 Intelligence . If desired, you can use two Larval Tears to respec your character and back just to solve the riddle. Alternatively, you can use a combination of intelligence-boosting equipment and effects: (Helm) Haima Glintstone Crown (+2 INT) (Helm) Hierodas Glintstone Crown (+2 INT) (Helm) Imp Head (Cat) (+2 INT) (Helm) Karolos Glintstone Crown (+3 INT) (Helm) Olivinus Glintstone Crown (+3 INT) (Helm) Queen's Crescent Crown (+3 INT) (Helm) Witch's Glintstone Crown (+3 INT) (Helm) Twinsage Glintstone Crown (+6 INT) (Talisman) Marika's Scarseal (+3 INT) (Talisman) Marika's Soreseal (+5 INT) (Talisman) Stargazer Heirloom (+5 INT) (Great Rune) Godrick's Great Rune (+5 INT) - requires consuming a Rune Arc to activate the buff, after which it will last until death (Weapon) Grafted Blade Greatsword (+5 INT) - Using the special skill boosts all stats by 5. Using the skill requires 14 DEX and 40 STR (27 when 2-handed) (Flask of Wondrous Physick) Intelligence-knot Crystal Tear (+10 INT) - lasts for 3 minutes upon consuming the flask After casting the spell, revealing a plot-point, go back to Goldmask and tell him what you found out. After this, you can talk to Brother Corhyn, and he will offer to sell you the Immutable Shield incantation. After leaving them (reloading in the same place won't make them disappear), Goldmask and Corhyn will move to the bridge south of Stargazers' Ruins right above the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins Site of Grace. [ Map Link ] A dialogue option also appears to give Brother Corhyn the Tonic of Forgetfulness upon advancing his questline to Mountaintops of the Giants , near the Stargazers' Ruins. Corhyn will refuse the potion and the item will remain in the player's inventory, but it will change the final step in this questline. After completing Crumbling Farum Azula , Goldmask can be found in Leyndell, Ashen Capital , he moves to the bottom of the colosseum cliffs facing the west side of the Erdtree Sanctuary Site of Grace.. He will give you the Mending Rune of Perfect Order . Reload the area to loot Goldmask's Set . Corhyn can then be found at one of the possible two locations: Corhyn location 1: It is advisable to check for him here first, as the game loads you into Leyndell, Ashen Capital after you finish the main boss fight at Crumbling Farum Azula . He will be near the base of the giant spiral spear. Speak with him to exhaust all dialogue and then, after reloading the area, you can find a Flail , Corhyn's Bell Bearing , and Corhyn's Robe where he was sitting. [ Map Link ] Corhyn location 2: If you offered Brother Corhyn the Tonic of Forgetfulness , he will remain at the bridge south of the Stargazers' Ruins where you last saw him. Talk to him; he'll be unaware of Goldmask's absence. Reload the area and then collect all three of the above items where he was. Note: If you don't complete the questline, you can find both Corhyn's Bell Bearing and Corhyn's Robe on a cliff east of the colosseum, in Leyndell, Ashen Capital . Dialogue in Elden Ring: Brother Corhyn Introduction: Oh, I see you've just arrived. Welcome to the Roundtable Hold. I'm Corhyn, a man of the cloth. I teach incantations, the strength granted us by the Two Fingers, and explore the secrets of the Golden Order. So that one day, if a Tarnished of the Roundtable Hold should become Elden Lord, I might counsel them, ensuring order regains its proper form, righting rule over men. By the way, do you still see it? The guidance of grace. ( I don't see it ) Ah, well, that is unfortunate. But no cause for despair. It's likely a temporary condition, I'm told. For whatever reason, it happens from time to time. Just keep your chin up, and stay the path. I pray the great guidance of grace returns to you. What is it? Has the guidance of grace returned to your vision? ( I see it ) You do! Wonderful news. Most Tarnished are blind to it these days. You are something of a rare breed. Well, what do you say? Care to learn an incantation of the Two Fingers? Subsequent Visits § : Ah, you appear to be doing well. Very good. Well then, would you like to learn an incantation? Further study of incantations, is it? I can happily spare the time, and applaud your enthusiasm. [Giving any other prayerbook] That... is a work of heresy. Its incantations bear no lineage from the Erdtree. (sigh) Very well... I'll take it off your hands. [Giving the Golden Order Principia ] This...is a volume of incantation. It's good to see your enthusiasm. Indeed, I will happily take it off your hands. [Leave] May the Golden Order shine through you. Leaving the Roundtable Hold: There's something I should mention to you as well. I'm thinking of leaving the Roundtable Hold. Do you know of the noble Goldmask ? Though he was a Tarnished, living outside the Lands Between, he was a great scholar, who foresaw the coming guidance of grace. And now, I hear he has come to the Lands between alone, to contemplate the Golden Order... I wish nothing more than to seek his instruction, and perhaps even help him in his research. Elden Ring Brother Corhyn Notes & Trivia FAQ: What happens if you kill Corhyn in Elden Ring? Corhyn can be accidentally killed or found dead in some cases if players progress too far without interacting with him. Some players have even mistaken him for an enemy soldier due to his appearance in the environments he is found in. Attack him and he will use his Flail and Sacred Seal to Heal himself during combat. If killed he drops Corhyn's Bell Bearing . Flail . Corhyn's Robe . Players have attempted to undo this action by going to the Church of Vows and seeking absolution, however this action does not resurrect fallen NPCs and can only absolve any hostile relationships. Players have also reported finding him dead at his second location: north of Altus Highway Junction after meeting him at the Roundtable Hold . With Corhyn dead, you may miss out on his merchant stock: a few Incantations and items related to the parts of his questline that involve Goldmask . For example, progressing through his questline will enable him to sell you the incantation Immutable Shield . It is possible to progress through the Goldmask questline without Corhyn, so long as you follow the questline steps and do not require the locational hints Corhyn provides. After casting the Law of Regression at the relevant location in Leyndell, Royal Capital , look for Goldmask on the cliff above and tell him the secret as usual. The next steps will occur after the Capital of Ash event is triggered and you find Goldmask at his final location. He will be in Leyndell, Ashen Capital at the level below the colosseum cliffs where he stood previously (facing the west side of the Erdtree Sanctuary Site of Grace). He will give you the Mending Rune of Perfect Order . Reload the area to loot Goldmask's Set . Corhyn Other Notes After meeting Brother Corhyn for the first time, you'll receive the Prayer Gesture . If provoked, Corhyn wields a Flail and a sacred seal, which he uses to cast Heal . If you manage to burn the Erdtree before ever reaching the Altus Plateau, meaning Brother Corhyn never leaves the Roundtable Hold, he will die when the Roundtable erupts into flame. You can accomplish this by defeating Fia's Chosen within the Deeproot Depths, which unlocks a teleporter directly to the Capital. From there, you can access the Mountaintops of the Giants without passing through the Plateau proper. Brother Corhyn Lore Lore Items Related to Brother Corhyn Corhyn's Robe Robe of Corhyn the cleric. Even after exile, Corhyn refused to recant his prophecies. And for this, he was blessed with the guidance of grace. Since then, the cart wheel draped on his neck has served as a reminder. That true guidance awaits those with iron wills. Those with unwavering faith. Prophet Blindfold Blindfold of exiled prophets who foretold misfortune — and were persecuted and driven from their homes as a result. Why hesitate, if the path leading to the future is clear? Just close your eyes, and walk. Immutable Shield One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. Enchants shield held in the left hand with the light of regression, increasing all forms of non-physical damage negation and ailment resistance. Two concepts form the basis for Golden Order fundamentalism. One is the law of regression, to which this incantation relates. Golden Order Principia Prayerbook of the Golden Order fundamentalists. A dense and complex academic treatise that contains the Order's fundamental principles. Can be given to a learned cleric to gain access to the following incantations: Radagon's Rings of Light Law of Regression Radiant Gold Mask A mask designed to resemble a blazing golden halo. Created and left behind by Lord Goldmask, a staunch pursuer of Golden Order fundamentalism. Strengthens Golden Order incantations. Its striking design represents both the brilliant inspiration that once shone upon him, and the vision of a ring that he will surely find at the end of his pursuit. "To you who seek to shine as I do, wear it well!" Mending Rune of Perfect Order Rune discovered by the noble Goldmask. Used to restore the fractured Elden Ring when brandished by the Elden Lord. A rune of transcendental ideology which will attempt to perfect the Golden Order. The current imperfection of the Golden Order, or instability of ideology, can be blamed upon the fickleness of the gods no better than men. That is the fly in the ointment. Altus Plateau : Second Church of Marika Role Quest NPC and Summonable Cooperator Voiced by Shaun Dooley Bloody Finger Hunter Yura is an NPC in Elden Ring . He is a hunter of Bloody Fingers and possesses knowledge of Dragon Communion . He can be summoned as an NPC Summon for the fight against the dragon he mentions, Flying Dragon Agheel , after speaking to him. See Bloody Finger Hunter Yura Lore Be on your way. Perhaps we will meet again, if fate permits Bloody Finger Hunter Yura Location in Elden Ring Bloody Finger Hunter Yura can initially be found under an overpass directly northeast of Seaside Ruins in southern Limgrave. [ Map Link ] This NPC moves with your progress This NPC can be fought. If defeated, drops: 1000 Runes , Nagakiba Bloody Finger Hunter Yura Questline: How to complete Bloody Finger Hunter Yura's Quest [Required] Bloody Finger Hunter Yura can initially be found under a ruin directly northeast of "Seaside Ruins" Grace [ Map Link ] in southern Limgrave. He will warn the Tarnished not to explore Agheel Lake because of the danger of a dragon. In order to progress Yura's quest, the player must speak with him at least once, either in this location, or after the Nerijus fight at his location north of Murkwater Cave. [Optional] Kill the Dragon in Agheel Lake [Missable] Yura will congratulate the player and inform them of the location of Church of Dragon Communion, where they can use the heart of the dragon. [Required] Upon approaching Murkwater Cave , the player will be invaded by Bloody Finger Nerijus . [Optional] Yura can appear as a white summon to help against the invader. [Optional] After defeating the invader, Yura can be found directly north of Murkwater Cave, he's under a tunnel-like ruin. Here he will explain about his task of hunting down Bloody Fingers. [ Map Link ] After the player talks to him in this location, he will move back to the campfire near Seaside Ruins. To progress the questline player must find a Red Summon Sign at the Main Academy gate site of Grace in Raya Lucaria [ Map Link ]. From the Main Academy Gate site of grace, travel north past the blue seal, and Yura's invasion sign will be near the first break in the bridge. Enter his world and defeat Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin, if defeated you will get Ash of War: Raptor of the Mist . Afterward, talk to Yura who will be standing against the railing near to where his summon sign was unless the player has progressed too far in the game; if so, he will leave Nagakiba in his initial location, northeast of Seaside Ruins Grace . You must speak to Yura at least once for him to move to Raya Lucaria. If Yura or the player dies during this fight, Yura will not die, and the player can try again. Winning this fight will reward first a Rune Arc and Furlcalling Finger Remedy , upon returning to your own world you will recieve Ash of War: Raptor of the Mists , and upon speaking to Yura you will receive Smithing Stone [5] . If Yura has been helped in Raya Lucaria before doing the optional quest line path, then they won't be there to congratulate you winning against the dragon etc., nor they won't appear against Bloody Finger Nerijus, nor will they appear directly north of the Murkwater Cave inside the tunnel-like path after defeating Bloody Finger Nerijus. [Required] Yura may be found at the Second Church of Marika on the Altus Plateau . Talking to him will reward the Nagakiba and lead to a battle with Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger . [ Map Link ] Defeating Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger will reward you with the Purifying Crystal Tear , Eleonora's Poleblade , and one Furlcalling Finger Remedy . Yura, whose body is taken over by Shabriri , can be found at the Zamor Ruins Site of Grace [ Map Link ]. Shabriri will try to persuade you to follow the path of the Frenzied Flame. You can kill Shabriri to obtain the Ronin's Set , or if you accept the Frenzied Flame from the Three Fingers , the set will be found on the ground where Shabriri stood. If Yura's quest is incomplete before he is possessed by Shabriri , you can still obtain most of the related items. Eleonora will invade at the Second Church of Marika , and defeating her will still grant you the Purifying Crystal Tear , Eleonora's Poleblade , and a Furlcalling Finger Remedy . The Nagakiba can be found at Yura’s last location before being possessed: at his camp northeast of the Seaside Ruins Site of Grace [ Map Link ], under the pass below the Murkwater Coast Site of Grace [ Map Link ], or near the edge of the bridge close to the Main Academy Gate Site of Grace [ Map Link ]. Yura will disappear after you enter the hall of the Rold Lift. Dialogue in Elden Ring: Bloody Finger Hunter Yura Introduction Ah, you must be the new Tarnished. You'd do well to steer clear of Agheel Lake, fledgling. A dragon roosts there... And it's as fearsome as it is majestic. So, unless you're mad, or wish to be burned alive... Stay clear of the lake. Don't be a fool. Turn back, before it's too late. During Bloody Finger Nerijus invasion If it isn't Nerijus, The Bloody Finger. The end is nigh. For you, and your cessblood. After Bloody Finger Nerijus invasion Ah, we meet again. To have fought Nerijus and lived, you must have seen your share of battle. I am Yura, as you might recall, hunter of Bloody Fingers. Tarnished held in thrall by cessblood. Zealots who stalk their own. If you stay the path, you are certain to face more of them. Just remember, no kinship with their ilk remains. Their madness precludes it. Don't let your emotions stay your blade. Introduction if not spoken to before Bloody Finger Nerijus Invasion Just joining the fray, Tarnished? Well, you fought Nerijus and survived. That alone deserves commendation. I am Yura. Hunter of Bloody Fingers. Tarnished held in thrall by cessblood. Zealots who stalk their own. If you stay the path, you are certain to face more of them. Just remember. No Kinship with their ilk remains. Their madness precludes it. Don't let your emotions stay your blade. One last word of warning. Stay clear of Agheel Lake. A great dragon roosts there. And it's as fearsome as it is majestic. So, unless you're mad, or wish to be burned alive... stay clear of the lake. Be on your way. Perhaps we will meet again, if fate permits. After dying to Agheel Lake Dragon, and returning to the Seaside Ruins location You bloody halfwit. Picking a fight with a dragon? Well, I can tell you want to see it through. Seems I'm forever crossing paths with hotheads like you. I can tell you want to see it through. Fools will be fools. Fight all the dragons you like. § After killing Agheel Lake Dragon, and returning to the Seaside Ruins location Beautiful work, felling that dragon. And as such there's something you might like to know. That heart you brought back, its used in Dragon Communion. If you should find yourself overcome by hunger for the heart, yearning for its strength, then seek the decrepit church, on the little island off the western coast. You must not forget though. Those who partake in Dragon Communion will one day shed their humanity. Their hunger for dragon, their yearning, only worsens. Until the floodgates burst, unleashing eternal torment. The strength of a mighty dragon. Magnificent, but deadly. Its no surprise that Dragon Communion is ruinous. After summoning Yura to help kill the Agheel Lake Dragon, and returning to the Seaside Ruins Location There you are. That was my first dragon hunt in quite some time. Paired up with a hothead like you, it was just like old times. Now that you've so impressively felled that dragon, there's something you should know. That heart you brought back, its used in Dragon Communion. If you should find yourself overcome by hunger for the heart. yearning for its strength, then seek the decrepit church, on the little island off the western coast. You must not forget though. Those who partake in Dragon Communion will one day shed their humanity. Their hunger for dragon, their yearning, only worsens. Until the floodgates burst, unleashing eternal torment. The strength of a mighty dragon. Magnificent, but deadly. Its no surprise that Dragon Communion is ruinous. Other Be on your way. Perhaps we will meet again, if fate permits. § After invading Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin Wretched worms, leave me be... Ah, oh, it's you. Thanks for your help there. That Bloody Finger was a thorn in my side. And now I'm finally rid of him. Here's a token of thanks. Please take it. I may not have much time. I'm dying to see you, Eleonora... Violet Bloody Finger... Yes, I've been tracking Eleonora for quite some time. She is the deadliest of all the Bloody Fingers. She's felled many an old hand already. But in spite of her cessblood zealotry, Eleonora is a proud knight. If she comes for you, do not think twice. You must flee. There is no shame in self preservation. § At the Second Church of Marika Eleonora, it seems I am no match for you. But I've learned a thing or two myself, you see. I've sliced the finger off. Please, please, Eleonora, yield to the cessblood no longer. Do not stain the immaculacy of your sword, your flesh, your fire... After being attacked (Combat) Too late for you, eh? Well, if you've succumbed to cessblood... it's better that I finish you here. (On player kill) I had no choice. Your death could have been much worse. Upon defeat I must not die... until she is eradicated. Elden Ring Notes & Trivia for Bloody Finger Hunter Yura In combat, Yura wields a Nagakiba . When fighting him after he is possessed by Shabriri, he moves his sword to his left hand, and now has a Frenzied Flame Seal , using it to cast Unendurable Frenzy , Inescapable Frenzy , and Howl of Shabriri (insert other spells) Eleonora appears to have taken part in Dragon Communion based on her armor and spells used during the invasion. This explains how Yura knows about Dragon Communion and how it works, as well as the dangers of it. Bloody Finger Hunter Yura Lore Lore Items Related to Bloody Finger Hunter Yura Nagakiba Katana with a ferociously long blade. Signature weapon of Yura, hunter of Bloody Fingers. Reminiscent of a reinforced spear, its imposing length can be put to good use with powerful thrusting attacks. Iron Kasa Iron kasa of the man who calls himself Shabriri. Crafted to imitate the woven straw hats worn in the Land of Reeds. The man, once known as Yura, kept a woman in the deepest reaches of his heart. Ronin's Armor Armor of the man who calls himself Shabriri. Highly functional and heavily worn. The man, once known as Yura, kept a woman in the deepest reaches of his heart. Dialogue Related to Bloody Finger Hunter Yura Shabriri "I fear that you were previously acquainted with this vessel. Well, that is most unfortunate. For he is dead. As for his flesh, he gave it to me, Shabriri."
